Friends, we had a bit of a campaign setback last night and I’m hoping I can count on your support to get us back on track.
A huge part of our grassroots outreach efforts is running digital ads, because this competitive primary will be determined by how many persuadable Democratic voters we’re able to reach before my May 14th primary.
Digital ads let us find and communicate with folks who might not have heard our message yet — maybe all they’ve seen is a thousand TV ads for my multi-millionaire opponent.
Those are voters we need to reach, team , and that becomes even more challenging when we miss fundraising benchmarks like our Digital Ads goal. I’d hate to have to cut back on our upcoming voter outreach plans if we can’t turn things around.
Raising an extra $5,000 today would do wonders towards getting us back on track and helping us continue to fund our digital ads, so would you please consider pitching in $25 split between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand right away? name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: GOOD NEWS: Six HUGE environmental victories YOU secured for our planet
body:
Wins like these go to show: when we fight, we win. |
---

** **
|
Our movement has been racking up BIG wins this year, thanks to our advocacy with the Biden-Harris administration and the generosity of LCV members like you, Peter.

I wouldn't want you to miss a single detail about these historic wins and everything we've done, together, to get here. _**Wins like these go to show: when we fight, we win.**_

In the last month, LCV and the environmental movement won dozens of new environmental protections and clean energy advances. These include new policies to cut pollution from power plants, $7 billion for the Solar for All fund, a long-awaited hazardous substance designation for toxic PFAS "forever" chemicals, and a new partnership to protect freshwater resources, as well as the opening of applications for the American Climate Corps.

_Here are some highlights of our Earth Week wins:_
1. **_WIN:_ EPA Announces New Protections Against Power Plant Pollution**

The EPA released new policies to tackle pollution from power plants after _tens of thousands_ of LCV members wrote in to support stronger protections.

These policies will reduce carbon emissions from existing coal and new natural gas power plants, update and strengthen the Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS), cut wastewater pollution, and implement new regulations on coal ash.

Pollution from power plants, including arsenic, soot, mercury, and other toxic materials, threatens the health and safety of our communities, especially those living nearby, which are disproportionately low-wealth communities and communities of color.

The new safeguards will help to protect the climate and provide billions of dollars in public health benefits nationwide each year.
2. **_WIN:_ U.S. Government Launches the American Climate Corps**

LCV members like you were at the forefront of the fight to pass the Inflation Reduction Act, the strongest legislative action _in history_ to combat climate change. Now, one of its signature initiatives, the American Climate Corps, is ready for launch.

Modeled after President Franklin D. Roosevelt's Civilian Conservation Corps, the initiative will put over **20,000 young people** to work fighting the damaging effects of climate change, and will expand the country's clean energy and climate-resilient sectors.

The program will prepare participants with skills to advance their careers, expand their eligibility for graduate programs, and place them in priority communities across the country. [If you, or someone you know, are ready to work for a better future for our climate, apply today >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ecwe~-rhw/K2N4akg0aFIrQ211NE0rOVpoZ1N3YWV6TGc4TW1abkRDbEo3Wk11Q2FJTEJlYy8xclQwSG1ZZlplUEREVkRPRG9YQVVSZFBJTnE5RldiSU9ETmNMYW1Ccys0R3BhakxUdzRKVHRRVitOcTA9S0/)
3. **_WIN:_ Massive Expansion of Solar Energy**

President Biden announced that the EPA will invest $7 billion in grants to help communities nationwide access the environmental and cost benefits of residential and community solar, another example of the historic climate action that's being made possible by legislation that LCV members like you helped pass into law.

The grants will be awarded to state, local, and tribal governments, as well as municipalities and non-profits. Projects funded by the grants are concentrated in low-income communities where residents often spend up to 30% of their income on energy costs. EPA estimates that these projects will save households a total of $8 billion on energy bills over the life of the program.

The projects will also create 200,000 jobs and advance President Biden's Justice40 initiative to drive at least 40% of federal investments to address environmental inequities into low-wealth communities and communities of color.
4. **_WIN:_ Fighting to Eliminate "Forever Chemicals" From Our Water**

After years of advocacy by our movement, EPA has listed PFOS and PFOA, two toxic "forever chemicals" linked to various types of cancer and other health issues, as hazardous chemicals under the Superfund program. This designation will expedite PFAS clean-up operations nationwide in order to cut PFAS pollution, protect public health and the environment, and hold polluters accountable to clean up our land and the water we drink.
5. **_WIN:_ Restoring Wetlands Across the Nation**

Speaking of clean water, the Biden-Harris administration has launched the "America the Beautiful Freshwater Challenge: A Partnership to Conserve and Restore America's Rivers, Lakes, Streams, and Wetlands" to protect and restore 8 million acres of wetlands and 100,000 miles of rivers and streams nationwide.

This urgently needed effort seeks to undo damage from last year's extremist Supreme Court decision, _Sackett v. EPA_ , which stripped protections from over 90% of the country's wetlands. The partnership has over 100 inaugural members, including LCV, 34 state and local governments, and eight Tribes, who together will work to ensure that our nation's freshwater resources are protected for current and future generations.
6. **_WIN:_ Expanding San Gabriel Mountains and Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monuments**

Last but certainly not least, our movement notched a HUGE victory when President Biden announced that he would expand the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument and the Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument.

_**Thousands of LCV members like you wrote to the President to demand that he take action -- and because you acted, generations of people will be able to enjoy these majestic protected landscapes.**_

Peter -- victories like these don't just happen. It takes hard work, tireless advocacy, and ongoing support from LCV members like you. _Thank you._

We'll be in touch soon with more details on our campaigns and more ways for you to help fight for people and our planet.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

P.S. If you're able, I hope you'll [chip in to LCV today](https://links.messages.lcv.) to help secure more incredible victories like these. |

We are working hard to meet as many people as possible around the 5th congressional district and earn your support. Please get your friends to vote. The last day to vote is June 18. | == | == If you would like to volunteer, make phone calls, and help with the McGuire campaign efforts in Virginia for Congress please contact the McGuire Team Campaign Manager Teemu Garrity at 248 303 9747 or email him at teemu@mcguireforva.com With your help we will win and help Trump pass the America First agenda so we can Save America! McGuire Poll Numbers:== The following is some of what I have been up to around the district! | Success for 911 Dispatchers! | | Getting results as a team! We will have a ceremonial bill signing with Governor Glenn Youngkin for the McGuire Senate Bill 630 on Tuesday, May 14, noon at the Richmond Capitol. Thanks for all the teamwork to get this signed and delivered for the people! I visited all 24 locality 911 dispatch units in the 5th Congressional district to thank them and listen to their concerns. This legislation is what those dispatchers asked me for and I am proud my team and I will deliver. 911 dispatchers do so much for our community. This legislation will add 911 dispatchers to the definition of public safety officer/ First Responder. Our dispatchers are the first point of contact for the 911 caller and offer critical and life saving communication to victims and first responders. | Trump has Record 100K Rally Crowd | | | 100,000 people! Patriotism is on the rise and Virginia is in play. == | My Dad Age 82 | | Charlie Kirk Fox News | | Charlie Hurt, from Chatham in the 5th, told the Fox News audience how Donald John Trump ripped Biden for withholding weapons to Israel. Israel, our most important ally, has been at war since the Oct 7 Invasion when Hamas terrorist murdered, raped, and kidnapped innocent Israeli and American civilians. It's time for a change and Jean Gannon will take us in the right direction. Vote for Jean as your Republican National Committeewoman on June 1, 2024 at the Hampton Convention Center. Visit www.Jeangannon.com for more info. | == | == | He Lost Our Support | | My opponent told us he supported Trump, but he did not. He lost my support and the support of the district when he betrayed Trump when the chips were down in May 2023, when we found out he disrespects his constituents, and when he worked with the democrat team to embarrass us and take out the republican team. Bob spent months trashing President Trump around the district and got caught lying about it live on CNN. Everyone knows Trump cannot trust Bob and neither can we. I am answering the call. body:
|
#
Team, the Supreme Court is fundamentally broken right now. It’s time we expand the Supreme Court — here’s why: **In our democracy, the Court is not supposed to be a bastion of partisan interests and biased Justices.** However, Donald Trump abused his presidential powers to appoint extreme, right-wing justices to the Court that will leave behind a harmful legacy for decades to come. The number of seats on the Supreme Court has changed several times before, and it needs to change again. **[If you agree, add your name in support of the _Judiciary Act_ , legislation that would help right Donald Trump’s wrongs and restore the balance of the Supreme Court. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84896333/473004283/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDFlMjcxYi04ZDExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=USFtnNTvteseVfrrGPCjhU2XIy9192QDIK7RuTCtvX0=&emci=33f64914-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=801e271b-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6227932)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84896334/473004284/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDFlMjcxYi04ZDExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=USFtnNTvteseVfrrGPCjhU2XIy9192QDIK7RuTCtvX0=&emci=33f64914-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=801e271b-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6227932)
---
The impacts of Donald Trump’s appointments are devastating — on multiple fronts.
First, we’ve seen the courts overturn decades-long precedents, including the right to an abortion. I don’t need to explain how damaging the _Dobbs_ decision was.
The Supreme Court also delayed taking a case on whether Trump should have “absolute immunity.” The longer they delay, the more likely that Donald Trump could make it back to the White House, pardon himself, and dismantle the Justice Department from within. **It’s bad.**
Folks, the majority of Americans have an unfavorable view of the Supreme Court, according to recent polls. The Supreme Court should be an impartial, trustworthy institution to protect our democracy — but it’s become a breeding ground for controversial decisions that move our country back in time.
**[We need to take action before it’s too late. Sign your name to join me in support of the _Judiciary Act_ to expand the number of Supreme Court justices from 9 to 13. It’s the only way we will restore balance to the Court.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84896336/473004286/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDFlMjcxYi04ZDExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=USFtnNTvteseVfrrGPCjhU2XIy9192QDIK7RuTCtvX0=&emci=33f64914-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=801e271b-8d11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6227932)**

| Peter,

As we confront the housing crisis gripping our state and nation, I'm reminded of my own childhood experiences and the struggles faced by far too many families today.

### _From The Archives ..._
The article below was written shortly after the publication of my first book, _BOOMBUSTOLOGY: Spotting Financial Bubbles Before They_ Burst. The article was my attempt to generalize the approach I described in the book to non-financial decision-making. It was published on the _Harvard Business Review_ website and led to a surge of interest in my work around the generalist approach. I'd welcome any feedback!
Best,
_Vikram_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ec562c9c-0d8e-4823-b76c-bce18e37a017?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

> **ORIGINAL (2012) POST:[https://hbr.org/2012/06/all-hail-the-generalist](https://substack.com/redirect/34d04cf3-69c3-442a-a921-13ce1604f44a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We have become a society of specialists. Business thinkers point to "domain expertise" as an enduring source of advantage in today's competitive environment. The logic is straightforward: learn more about your function, acquire "expert" status, and you'll go further in your career.
But what if this approach is no longer valid? Corporations around the world have come to value expertise, and in so doing, have created a collection of individuals studying bark. There are many who have deeply studied its nooks, grooves, coloration, and texture. Few have developed the understanding that the bark is merely the outermost layer of a tree. Fewer still understand the tree is embedded in a forest.
Approximately 2,700 years ago, the Greek poet Archilochus wrote that "The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing." Isaiah Berlin's 1953 essay "The Fox and the Hedgehog" contrasts hedgehogs that "relate everything to a single, central vision" with foxes who "pursue many ends connected...if at all, only in some de facto way." It's really a story of specialists vs. generalists.
In the six decades since Berlin's essay was published, hedgehogs have come to dominate academia, medicine, finance, law, and many other professional domains. Specialists with deep expertise have ruled the roost, climbing to higher and higher positions. To advance in one's career, it was most efficient to specialize.
For various reasons, though, the specialist era is waning. The future may belong to the generalist. Why's that? To begin, our highly interconnected and global economy means that seemingly unrelated developments can affect each other. Consider the Miami condo market, which has rebounded quite nicely since 2008 on the back of strong demand from Latin American buyers. But perhaps a slowdown in China, which can take away the "bid" for certain industrial commodities, might adversely affect many of the Latin American extraction-based companies, countries, and economies. How many real estate professionals in Miami are closely watching Chinese economic developments?
Secondly, specialists toil within a singular tradition and apply formulaic solutions to situations that are rarely well-defined. This often results in intellectual acrobatics to justify one's perspective in the face of conflicting data. Think about Alan Greenspan's public admission of "finding a flaw" in his worldview. Academics and serious economists were dogmatically dedicated to the efficient market hypothesis -- contributing to the inflation of an unprecedented credit bubble between 2001 and 2007.
Finally, there appears to be reasonable and robust data suggesting that generalists are better at navigating uncertainty. Professor Phillip Tetlock conducted a 20+ year study of 284 professional forecasters. He asked them to predict the probability of various occurrences both within and outside of their areas of expertise.
Analysis of the 80,000+ forecasts found that experts are less accurate predictors than non-experts in their area of expertise. Tetlock's conclusion: when seeking accuracy of predictions, it is better to turn to those like "Berlin's prototypical fox, those who know many little things, draw from an eclectic array of traditions, and accept ambiguity and contradictions." Ideological reliance on a single perspective appears detrimental to one's ability to successfully navigate vague or poorly-defined situations (which are more prevalent today than ever before).
The future has always been uncertain, but our ability to navigate it has been impaired by an increasing focus on studying bark. The closer you are to the material, the more likely you are to believe it. In psychology jargon, you anchor on your own beliefs and insufficiently adjust from them. In more straightforward language, a man with a hammer is more likely to see nails than one without a hammer. Expertise means being closer to the bark, and less likely to see ways in which your perspective may warrant adjustment. In today's uncertain environment, breadth of perspective trumps depth of knowledge.
The declining returns to expertise have implications at the national, company, and even individual level. A collection of specialists creates a less flexible labor force, one that requires "retraining" with technological developments creating constantly shifting human resource needs. In this regard, the recent emphasis in American education on "job-specific" skills is disturbing. Within a company, employees skilled in numerous functions are more valuable as management can dynamically adjust their roles. Many forward-looking companies are specifically mandating multi-functional experience as a requirement for career progress. Finally, individuals should manage their careers around obtaining a diversity of geographic and functional experiences. Professionals armed with the analytical capabilities (e.g. basic statistical skills, critical reasoning, etc.) developed via these experiences will fare particularly well when competing against others more focused on domain-specific skill development.
The time has come to acknowledge expertise as overvalued. There is no question that expertise and hedgehog logic are appropriate in certain domains (i.e. hard sciences), but they certainly appear less fitting for domains plagued with uncertainty, ambiguity, and poorly-defined dynamics (i.e. social sciences, business, etc.). The time has come for leaders to embrace the power of foxy thinking.
_**Vikram Mansharamani is a lecturer at Yale University, a Tiger21 Scholar, and author of Boombustology: Spotting Financial Bubbles Before They Burst (Wiley, 2011).**_

name: Tom Barrett
subject: ICYMI: Craig: Ensure petition signatures are applied equally
body:
The Board of Canvassers must apply rules equally, regardless of party | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664359968beb9b508c40a7e2&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0%26ss_email_id%3D664359968beb9b508c40a7e2%26ss_campaign_name%3DICYMI%253A%2BCraig%253A%2BEnsure%2Bpetition%2Bsignatures%2Bare%2Bapplied%2Bequally%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-05-14T12%253A32%253A08Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0&l=en-US&s=I6pSxjmz6x3_wPUI911hnFAZ6iI%3D)
---
| | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664359968beb9b508c40a7e2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0&l=en-US&s=lDvHMA-DARAxMRfyFIK9B7yYV1o%3D)
---
Spring is here and with it comes petition filings for federal and statewide elected offices. Two years ago, several Republican candidates for governor, me included, were removed from the ballot due to signature and circulator issues. I’d hoped lessons were learned for future candidates, but it appears not.Despite the high-profile lessons of 2022, candidates are finding themselves back in the same soup. The Board of Canvassers, a bipartisan body made up of two Republicans and two Democrats, that has jurisdiction over the petition signature requirements, will meet later this month to consider challenges to several candidates’ qualifications. My hope is that they apply the same rules and standards to those candidates, as they did in 2022, regardless of party affiliation.[Read the story on www.detroitnews.com](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664359968beb9b508c40a7e2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0&l=en-US&s=lDvHMA-DARAxMRfyFIK9B7yYV1o%3D)
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664359968beb9b508c40a7e2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0&l=en-US&s=lDvHMA-DARAxMRfyFIK9B7yYV1o%3D)
---
It would be highly unfair and blatantly partisan if the Board of Canvassers decides to play politics and ignores the mistakes made by the candidates in question.The people of Michigan need to have trust in the governing bodies that oversee the ballot access process. That trust will be entirely eroded if we see one year with numerous Republicans being kicked off the ballot and a free pass for Democrats in another year.Take the challenge facing Democrat Curtis Hertel, Jr., one of Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s top political allies, who incorrectly put “U.S. Congress” on his petitions as the title of the office he is seeking. While Hertel served 22-years in public office and comes from a dynastic Democratic family (his father was Speaker of the House, uncle a congressman and brother a sitting state senator), he listed an entire branch of government, not an office. “U.S. Congress” includes not just the U.S. House of Representatives but also the U.S. Senate. It is important to note, the 2024 ballot will include an open U.S. Senate seat along with the entire Michigan U.S. House delegation. Therefore, someone signing his petition really has no idea which office he is seeking. A pretty significant error for an experienced career politician.
---
[_ _ Support Tom Barrett _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664359968beb9b508c40a7e2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fchief-craig&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66433adb07ad4d29a18ac1b0&l=en-US&s=d9jEuQBlB38jAfiPtYmgxIU7Rac%3D)
---
To be clear: Michigan statute explicitly says that a candidate for U.S. House of Representatives list the title as “Representative to Congress,” and guidance from the Board of Canvassers is equally explicit.Running for office is a serious undertaking and requires campaigns to be diligent in their preparations and follow through. It appears some campaigns did not take this process seriously and mistakes were made.Congress is not an easy place to navigate, and it takes a serious person willing to understand the rules and procedures of the House to be an effective leader. A practice that we as voters should see being applied well before a candidate is sworn into office.My hope is that all candidates for any office requiring petition signatures are without flaws and submitted in accordance with the laws of our state. If not, there are consequences for those mistakes, and they should be applied equally across the board with no bias or favoritism. The Board of Canvassers should follow the rules and apply the laws as written.James Craig is former police chief of Detroit.
---

clean_body: The Board of Canvassers must apply rules equally, regardless of party | | | | | Spring is here and with it comes petition filings for federal and statewide elected offices. Two years ago, several Republican candidates for governor, me included, were removed from the ballot due to signature and circulator issues. I’d hoped lessons were learned for future candidates, but it appears not.Despite the high-profile lessons of 2022, candidates are finding themselves back in the same soup. The Board of Canvassers, a bipartisan body made up of two Republicans and two Democrats, that has jurisdiction over the petition signature requirements, will meet later this month to consider challenges to several candidates’ qualifications. My hope is that they apply the same rules and standards to those candidates, as they did in 2022, regardless of party affiliation. | It would be highly unfair and blatantly partisan if the Board of Canvassers decides to play politics and ignores the mistakes made by the candidates in question.The people of Michigan need to have trust in the governing bodies that oversee the ballot access process. That trust will be entirely eroded if we see one year with numerous Republicans being kicked off the ballot and a free pass for Democrats in another year.Take the challenge facing Democrat Curtis Hertel, Jr., one of Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s top political allies, who incorrectly put “U.S. Congress” on his petitions as the title of the office he is seeking. While Hertel served 22-years in public office and comes from a dynastic Democratic family (his father was Speaker of the House, uncle a congressman and brother a sitting state senator), he listed an entire branch of government, not an office. “U.S. Congress” includes not just the U.S. House of Representatives but also the U.S. Senate. It is important to note, the 2024 ballot will include an open U.S. Senate seat along with the entire Michigan U.S. House delegation. Therefore, someone signing his petition really has no idea which office he is seeking. A pretty significant error for an experienced career politician. To be clear: Michigan statute explicitly says that a candidate for U.S. House of Representatives list the title as “Representative to Congress,” and guidance from the Board of Canvassers is equally explicit.Running for office is a serious undertaking and requires campaigns to be diligent in their preparations and follow through. It appears some campaigns did not take this process seriously and mistakes were made.Congress is not an easy place to navigate, and it takes a serious person willing to understand the rules and procedures of the House to be an effective leader. A practice that we as voters should see being applied well before a candidate is sworn into office.My hope is that all candidates for any office requiring petition signatures are without flaws and submitted in accordance with the laws of our state. If not, there are consequences for those mistakes, and they should be applied equally across the board with no bias or favoritism. The Board of Canvassers should follow the rules and apply the laws as written.James Craig is former police chief of Detroit. | | | | | | | | mailto:campaign@tombarrettforcongress.com | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|--- PO Box 15221, Lansing MI 48901, USA

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial

## U.S. at Risk From Canadian Wildfires
Smoke from the [more than 100 active wildfires](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8yAUQJ8Gb1j82cYDwyd9stQhXTtaN3Ad3xZDCiRR3r5K585HRzo6H6f1BBQpXd7hQNe2vIJvdMd14NJwZVbTBbchKtQdOjnJYbTzPKhud2IeAYU3kwBhdDgbK7yyVk3aysF605FTQhkxSCPsMMqx90KHYdq81VYAbJIZgYFaLv1nptR23OIz37H0Ph9ddHtr18r0P6YWphY4-4SP2l_yCzO1vKWGJUGjnCAytdQjfyH3kCAQJP6gGDYqWHlB8DtWfqv8oJSw5gYcqPDvG0Rqz5fbcnkyvVBg-r-UQpp5VnNXXLg-KEaq48SMuBxA8Teu_bnqJwAA__-jcGrY) burning in Canada has drifted across the border into the United States, prompting Minnesota to issue an air quality alert. At least 90 fires are located in British Columbia and Alberta provinces, [filling the skies over parts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtywyAQAL9G6vDAAUIUFGncOW1KzRkO-xL0iCDW-O8zTp1yZ5ud_bhMF-TCy-0dZwotrxPGxg-arFBGgJlMn0ImAtI9BeWUHUbvLfT3IKM25KP12pIBQxmuiryMhKQcOd1zAAlGWmXkaAc1nKLUybocRz1KxKw6IylxW_fT58pLu1Muz_VB-ymuc1_CvbWtdvqtg3MHZ9wWOupLvWBvHAt1cI64YGJcxMElZd6pCuRdfP9g4fYUM6eDahN1Xr9I2MFfabBJObgiGXAxeY1pdFJHZ3Pu95C2g0vhOrjOyNuMXP5q2r9vfgMAAP__6nRlhw) of Montana, the Dakotas, Minnesota, and Wisconsin with haze Monday morning. The fast-moving blazes have engulfed more than 24,000 acres in western Canada. Authorities issued evacuation orders for thousands of residents in the Northern Rockies Regional Municipality and Fort Nelson First Nations in British Columbia. [See video of the fires here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwRsRxuDggaELW7p2tC5whKswREBj9e0rtWvnf_n1fdz2G1Cm8niHA-2IdQc_6IW75rPiUu1qCjYiSlwmtPN11qvZNi2nZI26rwK82hTcNZhFLyYaDD4I1Ju5w0RWCqmEnpUwep3XixdL0NfozWIEQJyZEhho1Hb5rFRGwpi_6wvbxddjyjaN8exseWPSMelOhJH-GpOu4NmZdKNhCVQeTLoXBaxMOg8FAvCTcojUsHOfoCMfqX51KKHz2OrBR0JqPNUD-9RseJ6UM_X1ypR4HED5d2H8C_ITAAD__yc8ZDc). Many of the wildfires have been [labeled "out of control](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQQNGvwR0WjAF7C4rXuNvXprQmMNgTYbPBZK39-yipU9_iSuftvtyRMx_rf9zJt1QWDI2ftFipjQSzmC76RAQ0dOT1qK2bbjcL3ean9O4AUqQQjZk0heRGoORUJAAcho49KDDKaqMm67TrgxqiHVOYhkkhJi2Mosit1P6j8NE2SvlVnlT7UPYu-621xymGfwJmAfN1Xf0Lt1J-qoD5oOsUMAc8MDIe8uIcE1c6Zau8rlQlcpWfX5i5vaR2VtvROtVvbc9d9fFxcc58ulEYte7I-ffa_jT4DgAA__8Tcl5J)," including one that started on Friday in British Columbia and has since spread to 4,200 acres, forcing the evacuation of the small town of Fort Nelson and the Fort Nelson Indian Reserve, officials said.
## Game Stop Stock Roars Again
Shares of GameStop soared as much as [110% Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuO2zAQRb9G6iiQowfFQkUadU6bUhhTQ2liPgySkOF8feDFltvfe3Bw_ty2G7LnePzGQEt1aUNb-aJtFGoQMGxDuy-OCKhvaVFajdNszAjtucwW9IhkYFb3uwTpDACgsaDNZMBOLS8gYZCjGuQ8TmrqrOz3UTs797NEdKoZJO1cU-7-Jo71JOff6aLc2RRav5y1PkvT_2pgbWB1HDFa6t54pvRZNLBGepUG1gMDlZqeotRkH6IkzEV8QEJLgUXkhJnjIR5c61tkuvhCLzLxEblSEYECfX_vKWL8hwKk1FIZPXVnDb7Ny_58sfdcJt0M8gjI_suy_tjsfwAAAP__44ZvDQ) as the meme stock was halted eight times for volatility before noon and closed more than $30 per share higher, a 75% rise. The run was triggered by a social media post from [Keith Gill, better known as "Roaring Kitty."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7ohg2fVPQfE16fK1V1oYFocLGMugRHn7U66-cjTNaL5uy83GFPftv81sWiiLdS0-eSGhUAAu2HsTmIF1z0aNioZpngn6uwFSc2CNROhxXYNHCIEmPesAUhH00YAElKRQTjSo4eKk9jQGN-lJWhtUh5J9bOW8fJe4tzuH9C5PPi-u5D6Ze2tH7fS_Dq4dXO2x86t-1AfOFl3iDq6ZM4uz2DPum3jE1t5is5lrK4ew2YnaintUgVLNarDO61GR1-ScBJAK9QrDCtb1p_HHK6YU6zB2KLdsY_rtaH9e-QkAAP__s81h0g) Gill's meme-stock exploits were popularized in the movie "Dumb Money," which showed how he helped run Game Stop stock up to $347.51 per share. Gill's social media post on Sunday was his first in three years. It [also boosted shares ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd0SwxpgUFK9xl9deaWG8OHvBwYJNovz9KVdfN9IUI83XZb4EynTf_ocdPacyh8j0xHmQ2kgws-lWnxAB-w69HvVg3fk8QHf1OBqdRtAaRrcao6x2AJhsMgr6xcaOPCgwatBGucFqe4qqX4cxRdc7FULSwihciUs9fRe68xVTfpcn1lMse5f9lfloov8nYBIwLbUstGT8SAFTfGR-VBQwhcoU84dqCZXum7wR81vyC5Gb3MKOjcshG5d4k0eliLJSwyZg6qpfjxflTM2OwqhtD5R_8_znjJ8AAAD__6wDYas)of AMC, which leaped 78%, and headphone maker Koss, which spiked 37%.
## Memorial Day Travel Nears Record Level
Memorial Day is shaping up to be the busiest travel weekend in 20 years, [with 43.8 million vacationers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ugzAURp_GbI7M9Q8weOjClq4dkcHX4bYGI3ObNG9fpXPHT9-RjnQ-rtM1UKb99h429JzKFBamO05WtkaCmUwTfUIE1A36tmut64fBQrN6NczBoR26Oc5aY8I0xM51gwFwRgXdkAcFRtnWqN661l0WpaPt0tLrXoWQWmEURuJSL5-Fdl4x5We5Y70sZWuyX5mPU-g3AaOAkVdcKefXJ2Ccc7mdAsbje4_Ep3ztF1TDfh6lcmAqu4DROKc0aFlxKTVKruGOWeLPgQtjlLzSKTfcSqWQZQxP-UD8wj0KGJvq4_GgnOl0nTDqtgX60zf8b6jfAAAA__9vfGt2) expected to travel 50 miles or more, up 4% from last year. The record was 44 million travelers in 2005. Road travelers alone are expected to hit a record 38.4 million, the highest number since AAA started tracking the number in 2000. Another 3.5 million will fly, and millions more will take buses, trains, or cruises. To avoid the worst traffic, experts say to hit the road before 11 a.m. or after 7 or 8 p.m. on Thursday or Friday, and before 1 p.m. on Sunday. If you're coming home on Memorial Day itself, best leave after 7 p.m. [Here are more travel tips.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO5CAQRL-mndlqGjB2QHAJ2Vx6oYWgmeEWm5HNjuW_X81uulElVaqn9--23Hwuebv_9SvbluriQ8svXnQvVE9qUV20iZlYdmyFEXqc5llT97AThhBRGNZSGC-SIIyTChpnIySOusuWkBRqoXDSoxiHgDJqk8IkJ_Q-CVDIMbe6D_9r3tqDU7nqi_ch1LUr9tHa8wD5B8gBufM8h8_Dtxr99S4AuaPV_QJybfcvLkBu4_MAcu9bIIcayAkJ5FZe65596aO_-pP5g7fY_6zekVIOQM7IUalZTogGyHW7jc8zl5KP0YDC--pz-SZrv3r6CgAA___LIWXu)

**CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR MAY 13, 2024**
**$9 Billion to Hamas??? Statement from Flemming Larsen:** I couldn't believe it when I saw it: the Biden Administration is giving $9 billion in "humanitarian assistance" to Hamas while they're still holding US and Israeli citizens hostage. And our member of Congress, Dina Titus, cast the vote for that funding! Not only that, but the Biden Administration is now withholding military aid and intel from the Israeli army while they're working to free those hostages, and his Nevada Campaign Chair, Dina Titus, remains silent. One of the big differences between me and Dina Titus is that, under no circumstances would I vote to give your tax dollars to terrorists as my opponent has, nor would I sit back while a President abandons our best ally in the region. That's why I'm so eager for the campaign season to begin: so I can hold Dina Titus accountable for her record that puts us and our allies last and terrorists first. ___________________________________________________________________

[Will you take a moment now to sign the pledge to affirm your commitment to ensure that our children and grandchildren receive a quality education free from ideological indoctrination?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1af2f0ba10854a2fa92d0154583bfd2f&_e=jiuO3DXWeiuvW1ZCue8kchSBNfewR67k1Gg-U59RCmkS3fK0daFKSobT4UOHlEkvUALofo5NLL7gNKKdgitYtXGep8fceRngWPUvL78TrXn4mks8472ncqUvxSDSXZAWkLYDM2ViAl682opggRNoqyMZuUHuhAh2mxiADKdz1MHZq876dtGH73Pyi9P83oN-_whDmHS8eSTzFSmV8x1C9gF32I_mHTeUDf15yQeCdlAhOw--Mylt60FmJ7WOwfTxg3FRyt7zte_bgbLo9QHb40v4jadfHfH6DT7pWmrOZKo8Rb8Y6Rsn8zymJIjcJR_rkm5caJUSEOa7VVT5YiysHrO9LjZKbvu043tZ-Sko6UThq4k6gQWAdf0Ae8NjO_Q_rKnOild-hoKAq5Xz5xxop910DYXuNptoGdLJKr2OXjA%3D)

I know I don't because woke curriculum promotes a victimhood mentality and perpetuates a culture of grievance rather than empowering students to succeed based on their merits.

**Do you share my concern about the erosion of parental rights and the imposition of ideological agendas on impressionable young minds?**

**If you believe parents should have the primary authority to guide their children's education and instill values that align with their beliefs, please sign the pledge below:**

Dear Fellow Patriot,

I'm reaching out today to express my deep concern regarding the introduction of woke curriculum in K-12 schools across our nation and ask for your help to [put a stop to it.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8bcb4edf42343f1accf0f5197e699d2&_e=g_l30gKLwyIRqZypM7guUxFQPapvz7wd4FkLedgpy7WREGyjl4ReB6iWCe918AgAHhWc_hOz2E7BsDANSq98HHTElPROQdqbA2SiPVmb9lEugwAD3eDCbRruJmbvB1oohWLZUMmR-aAi32HCI0fOzZ57gIfEjvOweZFaFmZYXqekpUgW43FKfDuYUUFcFNrX79NKI4T0wLsqdkD-ahmwuLpqsj7I_6EkhlRRlclifFOvxZJ8IpaGCD0PS-rSefnz3fIuSJ66P-9dq3kw9LdvvW4PASDBADPN_PdB6O6ZSMIaeKV03aimDWrFoVdlqp4zQ6fMo5M1UmJWKexsB4xCg8jkioliotFBOmaqdiP5uiL2DWEkr7cRjTr9kg64ERWS4obAsMIb1wqHEncK2RujHdS103lSuSp9Lh-QYmFyiY0%3D)

I strongly believe that the current trend of pushing radical ideologies like Critical Race Theory (CRT), gender identity politics, and other divisive teachings is harmful to our children's education and undermines the fundamental principles upon which our country was founded.

[Will you take a moment now to sign the pledge to affirm your commitment to ensure that our children and grandchildren receive a quality education free from ideological indoctrination?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8bcb4edf42343f1accf0f5197e699d2&_e=g_l30gKLwyIRqZypM7guUxFQPapvz7wd4FkLedgpy7WREGyjl4ReB6iWCe918AgAHhWc_hOz2E7BsDANSq98HHTElPROQdqbA2SiPVmb9lEugwAD3eDCbRruJmbvB1oohWLZUMmR-aAi32HCI0fOzZ57gIfEjvOweZFaFmZYXqekpUgW43FKfDuYUUFcFNrX79NKI4T0wLsqdkD-ahmwuLpqsj7I_6EkhlRRlclifFOvxZJ8IpaGCD0PS-rSefnz3fIuSJ66P-9dq3kw9LdvvRpnq4Y1L11TgZlX0_ZNlxEh2Seho5a1N_fH8_UdB7-M12s11taNWcBNVc4bL2ueYY-7DuEC2Mn5_vhTXQHaedXAj7uKWILkwa-Pwua7vviyIQgSadJlw-wRapJpV9RyjYxJwMtvIjFf4kL3YD3XxGw%3D)

Do you want to sit by and allow the infiltration of woke ideology into classrooms to continue leading to the politicization of education and the indoctrination of students with divisive and often inaccurate narratives about our history and society?

I know I don't because woke curriculum promotes a victimhood mentality and perpetuates a culture of grievance rather than empowering students to succeed based on their merits.

**Do you share my concern about the erosion of parental rights and the imposition of ideological agendas on impressionable young minds?**

**If you believe parents should have the primary authority to guide their children's education and instill values that align with their beliefs, please sign the pledge below:**

[**https://offers.americancornerstone.org/parental-rights-pledge/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8bcb4edf42343f1accf0f5197e699d2&_e=g_l30gKLwyIRqZypM7guUxFQPapvz7wd4FkLedgpy7WREGyjl4ReB6iWCe918AgAHhWc_hOz2E7BsDANSq98HHTElPROQdqbA2SiPVmb9lEugwAD3eDCbRruJmbvB1oohWLZUMmR-aAi32HCI0fOzZ57gIfEjvOweZFaFmZYXqekpUgW43FKfDuYUUFcFNrX79NKI4T0wLsqdkD-ahmwuLpqsj7I_6EkhlRRlclifFOvxZJ8IpaGCD0PS-rSefnz3fIuSJ66P-9dq3kw9LdvvUyKkXf3swjLnQnCp7wU_CxdYe0IWo_7fw2shZauUinDGnZSzkSE1ultpbmc5kCGj4MOMCwgaIn99CIrOb5GPUBYjoIZuXyctlTTjg_QkQ2rJp-USjSihlNrFAAy7gYP8SjV--L1ESwbnSdh8Qil5rA%3D)

| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T98f7d35d-99e1-48cc-ba05-6e7bc71bb8cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a10c98f-c478-4615-bf4e-27c31d0d8253/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

## Philly Area Meetup and Watch Party
Join us this Saturday for a social gathering of Dr. Cornel West and Dr. Melina Abdullah supporters and volunteers! Philadelphia is home to some of the best music the world has ever heard, and now it's your turn to join the band! body:

| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2546562/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi,
Pens are down on President Biden's first-term power sector agenda, and grades are in.

Today, Evergreen released [our final report card](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2546563/87SdQ4wZ) tracking the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) progress on a suite of key power sector rules—and the agency scored some well-deserved high marks. |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2546564/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| EPA **finalized nine historic standards** , achieving monumental progress on climate and clean air—progress that **wouldn't have been possible without your continued advocacy and the tireless efforts of EPA staff.**

These top grades are proof our collective action worked. You not only called for updated standards, but strong and ambitious ones—and EPA listened. [**Now, join us in thanking EPA staff for making these historic wins possible.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2546565/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[THANK EPA NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2546566/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| These final standards showcase unprecedented progress in cleaning up power plants, the largest industrial source of climate pollution. They mean fewer kids with asthma, safer drinking water, and less heavy metals and toxic pollution in our air all across the country.

I'm so proud of what we accomplished here, and I look forward to tackling the next phase of power sector advocacy together.

Onward, |
---

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vshCtrNWvN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oshCtrNWvN

Dear
Fellow Patriot,

If you
opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...

...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."

But this
email - isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never
thought I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that
folks will be talking about for generations to come.

Because
when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s
weren't as good as we tend to first remember.

Baseball
was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that
had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy
after another.

I'm
running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is
starting to look a lot like 1970s America.

You
remember what it was like:

►
Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we
could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license
plate numbers. Remember?

►
Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village
in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

►
Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists
in Iran. Remember?

Democrat
policies had brought America to its knees.

And now,
as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again."

There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.

Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.

And I
wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best
days are behind us."

But
listen, here's something I also want you to remember...

We
Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.

We put
classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.

And
America became a shining city upon a hill once more.

We can do
that again.

It starts
by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.

But
there's no way I can pull it off without you.

That's
why I'm asking you to rush back your Garvey for Senate
contribution of $35 or more right away.

I'm sorry
for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away...

And in
that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign
capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war
chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C.

That may
seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in
November.

Why?

First...
I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can
tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've
never seen before.

They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...

I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.

Second...
you know I'm not a career politician.

But I do
have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in
California...

…name recognition.

I'm no
Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to
President Reagan.

But
California voters know me.

And Adam
Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how
quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race.

As I'm
writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points
separating us.

We've got
a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we
only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine
is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and
our common sense message.

When you
rush your Garvey for Senate campaign contribution of $35 or
more...

...you're
helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers,
EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message:

You don't
have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less
safe, less prosperous, and less free.

This race
is the toughest in the nation.

But they
say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball.

And you
know I've done that plenty of times.

Now I'm
ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in
California as a common sense Republican.

But I
can't do it without you.

When we
win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...

...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.

It all
depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours.

You can
do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can
step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of
victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're
winning for all of America.

Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey #6

P.S. It's
the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun.
We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers
while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I
know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the
Republican Comeback Rally America needs. But Election Day is just
six months away. So please rush back your Garvey for Senate
campaign contribution of $35 or more as soon as you can. Thank
you!
--Steve

BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE

May 14, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Mary Peltola Votes to Allow Noncitizens to Determine U.S. House Seats

ANCHORAGE, AK - At the end of last week, the House passed legislation
that would require the Census Bureau to include a citizenship question
on all future censuses and exclude non-citizens from any headcount used
to determine population for representation in Congress and electoral
votes. To no surprise, Congresswoman Mary Peltola opposed the bill and
voted to allow the census to continue counting noncitizens.

As the border crisis continues to worsen under Joe Biden and Washington
Democrats, Peltola's latest vote raised some eyebrows.

Lieutenant Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, Republican candidate for Congress
responded saying, "Once again, Mary Peltola voted against the
priorities of the majority of Alaskans. Her latest vote in the House
proves that she cares more about noncitizens than the citizens of this
country. We should not be rewarding sanctuary cities that endanger the
country and encourage illegal immigration. We need to put American
citizens first and that's exactly what I will do when I am elected to
Congress."

body:
Election Day message from President Trump🇺🇸 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5596e5375e88/n41kepo7ku-12695014?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=e61ee3abbe&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

**Verse of the Newsletter:** __Matthew 7:8_ For everyone who asks, receives. Everyone who seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door will be opened._

I wanted to share the message sent from [President Trump](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0025b4bde5&e=25844e23a8), please see below. The America First movement begins with the principles of the party and that resonates with the people of the party. Nebraskans, today is one of the days your voice can be the loudest en masse. Join the record setting turnout of voters for the Nebraska Primary and support **Constitutional and Platform Republicans** from our Board of Education candidates to your local school boards, Federal to Legislative...be a part of Nebraska HISTORY - **Tuesday, May 14th, 2024!**

* * *

Many institutional politicos believe any variance from status quo politics as pushing divisive rhetoric. However, I believe the year of 2020 and July 9th, 2022 were tipping points, as an _**awakening of the people**_. An awakening that is ASKING questions and even more so, DEMANDING answers. I see this happening at the Republican National Committee (RNC) meetings among the newest members. You see it in Congress and the leadership saga. I see it happening in other states as I work with the state chairs, many of whom are newer to their positions than I am. One thing I can assure you of is this...from what I see in the new, competent and patriotic leaders from the other states, the awakening is growing faster and driven by leaders who will not yield.

We reached a tipping point in the Republican Party of Nebraska and it led to July 9th, 2022 and this is being mirrored at the national level. July 9th, 2022 saw a formidable majority of a governing body (State Delegates) saying, "Enough is enough!".

#1 We showed up
#2 We knew the rules

>From a small group of initial planners to a rally with 250 passionate Republicans the Friday before, we knew the rules and we showed up in force.

We prepared together.
We prayed together.
We persisted together.

And, we won TOGETHER.

Republicans of Nebraska...you were and are on the leading edge of change within this country. Change within the Republican party. It is unprecedented what occurred on July 9th, 2022 and the subsequent makeover of the NEGOP. However, all the change needed for Nebraska will not happen overnight and it will not come to fruition if you waiver. **You have to persist.** You have to see a vision of what this state and country could be again. We took back the party FOR the people, so the people can take back their LOCAL communities, FIRST.

I want America First and I want Nebraska First, let's secure North Platte First, and Kearney First, and Norfolk First, and Columbus First, etc. You have to engage your local county parties and bring your time, talents, and treasures. If it's not YOU, then who? And when? When it's too late? **2024 will not be successful without your direct involvement and that's the truth.**

You must vote every time and we must work together to secure our elections to secure our way of life.

Lastly, we have to face the hard truth that not all current elected leaders want to work WITH the party. Those officials who call **Constitutional and Platform Republicans** “radicals or terrorists” or that we are purging the party...they simply don’t get it. They bury their heads in the sand, pretending that today’s challenges are simply political, rather than existential or spiritual. Some officials say they are waiting for the dust to settle on the unprecedented change within the party. Some want the NEGOP and all the people to be more "Team" players. I can say beyond reproach that we have the receipts to prove time and time again attempts to connect and create the relationships that should be beneficial for the people's party. I believe that the elected officials who choose to work WITH the State Party are committed to working with The People. The elected officials that want that relationship, choose YOU the people, over lobbyists, special interests groups, wealthy donors, or echo chambers that perpetuate their legacies.

_The objectives of the party remain_...to maintenance the government of, by, and for the people and to further our princples. This is truly the END results we desire. Several politicos indicates our sole objective is to JUST elect Republicans...that is a MEANS to an END! The elected officials are the servants of the people. The party is the representative of the principles and people who promote the principles. That's what defines the DIFFERENCE between the party's...the PRINCIPLES.

President Trump has made significant effort to connect to Nebraska. He has a message for you, see below!

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

body:

|

| |
# **_AMAZING MOTHER'S DAY REPORT_**

Peter, I am so proud of and focused on all the wonderful people of Memphis I meet every day in the stores, on our streets, in our churches, and through social media...minus the approximate 500 repeat offenders who are committing crimes and terrorizing our community.

On Mother's Day, I parked my car on Pendleton in South Memphis, one of the most dangerous areas of the city, and I walked half a block alone, SAFELY, while passing a large group of men in their front yards drinking beer, whiskey, etc. I accidently left my car running for an hour and prayed, "Okay, God, I give this car over to You. You protect it" and HE DID.

I was honored to participate in the Mother's Day food give-away sponsored by Touched by An Angel Ministries, with chairman Larry Hunter, State Representative Republican candidate - District 88.

When I say I was proud of Memphis, I mean "I am proud of Memphis." I met a few hundred of the real folks of our community. Some were homeless and some slept in their cars or experienced the most minimal, base lifestyle offered. Many were truly in need and deserve better. I have been homeless myself. I have also experienced the pain of being a grandparent of a senseless murdered loved one.

As I was passing out food items to many who are down on their luck, there was no violence. One lady pulled me aside and said, "I need to talk with you. There is something about you that makes me want to talk to you. I need to talk." I listened to her tell me about the murder of her daughter. Detectives have been assigned to her case but when they get promoted, the case is passed to another detective, and on and on and on. I know and feel the pain of my fellow Memphians. That mother deserved better. We all deserve better. I am so glad the MEDIA is not my only filter for judging the people of Memphis.

Most of the money we need to get the approximately 500 criminals off the streets, to hire more police to protect our good people, goes to the federal government, which is approximately $34+ trillion in debt. They do not care about our community. They just want our money to spend. Well, it's time they start caring! Speaker Mike Johnson needs help in getting legislation passed.

Memphis will get BETTER WITH BERGMANN. Thank you for allowing me to serve on your behalf. Send me to Washington D.C. to help reduce that budget.

I want to send a special shout out to WMC channel 5. They came out to cover the Mother's Day Give-away event, and were the recipients of Mother's Day gifts, too.

Charlotte Bergmann

❤️ 😍 💖

clean_body: We are winning the hearts and minds of good people in Memphis | | | | | | | | AMAZING MOTHER'S DAY REPORT Peter, I am so proud of and focused on all the wonderful people of Memphis I meet every day in the stores, on our streets, in our churches, and through social media...minus the approximate 500 repeat offenders who are committing crimes and terrorizing our community. On Mother's Day, I parked my car on Pendleton in South Memphis, one of the most dangerous areas of the city, and I walked half a block alone, SAFELY, while passing a large group of men in their front yards drinking beer, whiskey, etc. I accidently left my car running for an hour and prayed, "Okay, God, I give this car over to You. You protect it" and HE DID. I was honored to participate in the Mother's Day food give-away sponsored by Touched by An Angel Ministries, with chairman Larry Hunter, State Representative Republican candidate - District 88. When I say I was proud of Memphis, I mean "I am proud of Memphis." I met a few hundred of the real folks of our community. Some were homeless and some slept in their cars or experienced the most minimal, base lifestyle offered. Many were truly in need and deserve better. I have been homeless myself. I have also experienced the pain of being a grandparent of a senseless murdered loved one. As I was passing out food items to many who are down on their luck, there was no violence. One lady pulled me aside and said, "I need to talk with you. There is something about you that makes me want to talk to you. I need to talk." I listened to her tell me about the murder of her daughter. Detectives have been assigned to her case but when they get promoted, the case is passed to another detective, and on and on and on. I know and feel the pain of my fellow Memphians. That mother deserved better. We all deserve better. I am so glad the MEDIA is not my only filter for judging the people of Memphis. Most of the money we need to get the approximately 500 criminals off the streets, to hire more police to protect our good people, goes to the federal government, which is approximately $34+ trillion in debt. They do not care about our community. They just want our money to spend. Well, it's time they start caring! Speaker Mike Johnson needs help in getting legislation passed. Memphis will get BETTER WITH BERGMANN. Thank you for allowing me to serve on your behalf. Send me to Washington D.C. to help reduce that budget. I want to send a special shout out to WMC channel 5. They came out to cover the Mother's Day Give-away event, and were the recipients of Mother's Day gifts, too. There's a good quote I heard from former University of Michigan quarterback, Tom Brady:
He said, **"The fish don't just jump in the boat."**
Meaning, the things you want don't just happen. You have to put in the work. I think that applies nicely to our race.
No matter what anyone may tell you, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. I am not going to win this Senate race just because there is a (D) next to my name on the ballot.
Just as we have swung toward Democrats in recent years, Michigan is known for swinging right on back. It was, after all, a few years ago that Donald Trump won here against Hillary Clinton.
The fish don't just jump in the boat.
I won't win this race without work.
But no one person can do it alone. I can only win if people like you who care contribute what you can toward our victory -- the resources we need to make it happen.

name: Bill Spadea
subject: A Monumental Weekend with President Trump!
body:
Peter, In the spirit of true American grit and the values that have sculpted our great nation, I am thrilled to extend a pers
|
---
| Peter, What a phenomenal weekend we had in Wildwood! As many of you know, we welcomed back President Donald Trump, a true leader ready to take the helm once again. **It's not every day that you get the chance to discuss the future of our nation with the President himself, and I’m here to share that incredible experience with you.** [**Check out my interview with our 45th (and soon to be 47th) President here.**](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/cfd6453c668c9d687e02abc9172b39a1/eJyNkNEKgkAQRf9lniVTC0qIEIlYrIio59jWAZdqXbbZzMJ_b7PwqaDnOfdc7jyAUHFFLIcYbnQPwwg8MCiklqgoLRVx0V7D4SCIAg9OUh3nprQa4sfXcAe0qTDqe0C1RodsN0masdV8v2CrzJGaG9fxpycYdZ7ZMmELaJqfYjxLml2d-wIxGYuvRbl0q2hnTo4viPQl9v2qqnp1ackesCfKs19xEsX0Ornd2VqMN0fLl87GtUaVf16RYf12Nk8xEWdZ) We kicked off the excitement at The Original Hot Spot Pizza on the bustling boardwalk, setting the stage for a day filled with spirited discussions and patriotic fervor. From early in the morning, the energy was palpable, with massive crowds gathering to show their unwavering support.
---
|
---
President Trump and I had a detailed conversation about his plans for America, the need to restore common sense in government, and how we can revitalize our nation’s strengths. His commitment to securing our borders and bolstering our global standing was clear. **It’s these principles that resonate with so many of us here in New Jersey and across the country.**

---
| **I was also honored to speak with key insiders like Ric Grenell, Jason Smith, and Jason Miller, who have been instrumental in the efforts to propel our country forward.** Their insights into the current political landscape and the strategies for the upcoming elections were nothing short of inspiring. As we gear up for what promises to be a historic return to leadership for President Trump, I am reminded of the strength and determination that defines us as Americans. This weekend was a testament to the spirit of New Jerseyans and patriots everywhere — ready to support a leader who upholds our values and liberty. **If you haven't yet joined our movement,** [**I encourage you click here to become part of the Common Sense Club today**](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/69f4e068f85bd262869dd63b408e0fa3/eJyNkE0LgkAURf_LW5vmVBCzE5EQrUXUOgZ95ZSOw_TKTPzvTR_UpqD1Pfc87uuAUAlFcQ4cLnRlbAQOGMyklqgorBWJ7JGyydgf-Q6UUh1mpj5p4N3X8ht4tBibOkCtRouslkGYxIvZJo0XiSW1MPbGnx7_44nmQZxC3_8UYyUpOlv3ETiZE94X5dKuorUpLV8Q6SP3vKZp3H0tFRW4lbuC2JCN3ayuPKyELAf3yNqE1qjy1ysSbJ_O_gYh0Gbz)—where we champion America's ideals and collaborate to secure a prosperous future for everyone. Let’s continue to drive momentum as we strive for a better tomorrow for New Jersey and the entire nation. Together, we can make a significant impact. With unwavering commitment to our nation, Bill Spadea
---
|
---
| Did you see this previous message from Bill? In case you missed it, check it out now: I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing the incredible kindness and generosity that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey. Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, something remarkable happened. Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. This act of kindness not only provided Penny with much-needed relief but also sparked a new friendship that warmed all our hearts.
When my wife Jodi and I visited Penny's home to witness the installation, we were deeply moved by the generosity extended by Ryan and his team. Not only did they donate the system and labor, but they also paid Penny's HOA fees for the entire year—an extraordinary gesture of compassion and solidarity. This moment reminded me once again why New Jersey is such a special place. When it comes to rallying around those in need, New Jerseyans stand out as the epitome of kindness and generosity. This is precisely what the Common Sense Club holds near and dear to its heart—making New Jersey a better place for all New Jerseyans. It's about extending a helping hand, fostering connections, and embodying the values of compassion and community. I invite you to watch the video of our meeting with Penny for the first time, and I hope it inspires you as much as it has inspired me. With gratitude, Bill
---

# U.S. SENATE
# REPUBLICAN NOMINEE?
# VOTE TUESDAY, JUNE 18
---
---
|
Friends, The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know.
On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine.
Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate.
After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith.
In fact, last week I decided to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race, because I want to make sure he wins.
Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall.
You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat.
When I was standing against unconstitutional Covid mandates, the big 2021 gun grab, the socialistic monument grab, the 2020 stealing of a presidential election and standing with J6ers who are being held as political enemies, there was only one of these candidates who stood with me in the fight.
That person was Chuck Smith.
Chuck Smith was one of the only politicians in the trenches and in the streets of Richmond standing with me to defend your Constitutional rights
Chuck is not a newcomer to Virginia politics. He served as the GOP Chair for the Virginia Beach Republican Party and successfully led Republicans to victory in all local, state and federal levels. Sorry, but where have these newcomers been? Have they been in the trenches with you and I for the past 4 years?
When President Trump ran for President the first time, many Republicans tried to keep some of President Trump's supporters from voting in the Republican Primary. Chuck successfully represented these supporters and won. Thanks to Chuck these Virginians were allowed to vote.
I truly believe all 5 candidates are good people and I'll support whoever the Republican nominee is, but I hope you will join me in casting a vote for Chuck Smith on Tuesday, June 18.
While I hope if elected the others would stand strong, I KNOW if elected Chuck will stand strong and not become apart of the DC Swamp.
Please donate Chuck's campaign by clicking the link below.
Chuck has a history of supporting President Trump, even from the very beginning. We can count him to support President Trump once elected so that we can truly make America Great Again!

VOTE TUESDAY, JUNE 18 | Friends, The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know. On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine. Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate. After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith. In fact, last week I decided to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race, because I want to make sure he wins. Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall. You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat. Chuck Smith was one of the only politicians in the trenches and in the streets of Richmond standing with me to defend your Constitutional rights Chuck is not a newcomer to Virginia politics. name: Rebecca Weber
subject: If they can do it to Trump, they can do it to you
body:
You know what they’re doing is wrong...

| |
---
| |
---
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7284umrntfa0q6kdmopkh58b9fuf6htm8muqpv8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)
---
| | When you turn on the news and see what the radical Left is doing, you might feel powerless to stop them.But I promise you that you aren’t.When you join the **_Association of Mature American Citizens Action coalition_** , you become an unstoppable force that politicians must respond to.**_They can ignore one person, and they can ignore two people – but they can’t ignore our two MILLION members._** That’s why we’re focused on _growing our numbers_ in the months to come – **[and why we’re counting on patriots like you to join today.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5dm77o5gv9rl3i4rdc85s8j5cj88f2gti2c8v7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)** You know what they’re doing is wrong...I know what they’re doing is wrong...and they know what they’re doing is wrong.But __they don’t care__.They’re willing to destroy everything that made our country great if it means they can destroy Donald Trump._They’re counting on seniors like you throwing in the towel – and that’s exactly**why you can’t**._ That’s why I hope you’ll take a stand today – not just for President Trump, but for sanity, for law and order, and for America as we know it.**[**Will you join AMAC Action today, and pledge a gift of $25 or more right away?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6lspvt892icu84egq8ijmkddfs4k8p3akk6atr8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)** The radical Left knows that seniors like you are standing in the way of their agenda.They know you see right through their lies and propaganda.And that’s why they want to shut you up. They’re pouring millions of dollars into silencing conservative seniors like you – and that’s why the Association of Mature American Citizens was created – and why we established our political action division.We’re mobilizing patriots like you by the millions, and making sure that your voice is heard.
---
| | My name is Rebecca Weber, I’m the CEO of AMAC.My late father started the Association of Mature American Citizens 17 years ago to provide a conservative alternative to radical left-wing senior's groups like the AARP.And AMAC Action is our hard-hitting political action committee – fighting in Washington and beyond for you and your values. AMAC Action has scored victory after victory on behalf of seniors like you, and with the help of seniors like you.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z97it0eb4l1kotrdtbvelqq5r78vt7veeqsu79h8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)
---
| |
* We played an instrumental role in passing the Born-Alive Survivors Protection Act, the Parents Bill of Rights Act, and the REINS Act on the federal level.
* We also stopped a horrendous Medicare for All scheme in its tracks that would have inserted the government even further into your private life.
* On the state level, we removed non-citizens from voter rolls, we banned private funding of elections from companies like Facebook, and set strict deadlines for mail-in ballots.

---
We’re one of the most influential groups in the country – and that’s thanks to patriots like you.But it’s never been more important that we grow our numbers, and grow our influence.But running and expanding an organization of this size isn’t exactly cheap. **[So if you’re in the position to join today with a generous donation of $25 or more, I hope you will.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfmk7958n4a7c3mgfln4dp81508n1hs3g05898v0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)** I am terrified the teenagers and twentysomethings won’t take up this fight... If we leave it up to the younger generations, corrupt officials like Letitia James will plunge our country into the third world.What’s happening to Donald Trump is bigger than any one President or political party...** _This will change our nation forever if they get away with it._** America as we know it is hanging by a thread.They’ve led a Witch Hunt against President Trump for eight years now, coming up empty-handed, unable to back their allegations time after time.All these years later, they still don’t have the evidence – they just have the power and the will to ignore law and order.And if they can do it to Donald Trump, you bet they can and will do it to you.It shouldn’t be up to us to save this country, but it is.Seniors like you are all that’s standing between America and total collapse.Sincerely,
---
| | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlu29a33e754koitsqqgmgrds4ndg7105225rgng_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctg6eo76chh2bs)
---
Rebecca Weber
