name: Lucas Kunce
subject: This is an existential threat to our grassroots movement.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
I’m not asking for a donation in this email. But I still need you to read it.
#
Peter,
Right now, grassroots movements like ours are facing an existential threat from one of the biggest email providers in the country — Google.
**I’m not going to ask you for a donation in this email.** But I do hope you’ll give me a moment to explain what’s happening and why it’s such a big deal for campaigns like ours that don’t rely on shady mega-donors and corporate PACs.
**Over the years, Google has amassed a market share of more than half of emails in the United States.** Whether you know it or not, that means they have incredible power over the content we see and the content we don’t — basically, what’s important enough to go to the normal inbox, and what goes to spam.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50206?refcode=em20240514-5507&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5507%2E614464%2E8CLpOX)
One example of this is the Verified Sender Program that Google introduced in 2022. When campaigns joined that program, Google ensured that their emails were sent to the primary inboxes of their supporters — where people actually saw and engaged with them — instead of spam. Fundraising surged as a result.
But when Google ended that program early last year, grassroots fundraising took a big hit. Emails are generally one of our biggest sources of online, small-dollar donations. But without the safeguards Google put in place, we had to dramatically limit the number of supporters with Gmail accounts that we could reach out to each day. It had a real, and lasting, impact on our campaign.
**Now, we’re seeing even tinier moves in Google’s algorithm having massive effects, on both campaigns and our political system as a whole.**
Fewer and fewer emails to Gmail accounts are getting through to people’s primary inboxes — not just for our campaign, but campaigns at all levels across the country. It’s affecting our ability to reach voters with critical information, to contact supporters about ways to get involved, and especially our ability to fundraise.
When emails are blocked, and small-dollar donations dip as a result, politicians begin to rely more heavily on those shady mega-donors and massive corporations who’ve made it their business to muck up our political process. And we already know how dangerous that is for our democracy.
**It’s a classic example of corporate monopolies amassing so much power that they pose a real threat to everyday people in our country.**
So now, I’m asking for your help to fight back in a few ways:
1. **Make sure your email provider knows you want to see these emails.** Whether it’s by clicking a link [**(like this one)**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50206?refcode=em20240514-5507&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5507%2E614464%2E8CLpOX) or replying to this email or simply marking an email that has gone to your spam folder as “Not Spam,” engaging with our emails is one of the best ways to prove that you’re an active member of this movement.
2. **Share your thoughts.** If you have ideas for how we can make these emails more interesting or engaging, our team would love to hear them. **[You can click here to fill out our quick survey and share your feedback.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/survey/lk-email-20240514-1_share-your-thoughts?t=3&akid=5507%2E614464%2E8CLpOX)**
3. **Get people talking.** Forward this email to a friend and let them know what’s happening here. Or even ask them to click on a link in this email too. This is an issue that should be on everyone’s radar — from voters, to donors, and the execs at Google who can actually do something about this.

I can’t tell you how much your support means to me, Peter.
Together, we’re going to keep building this grassroots movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real working people.
Thanks for everything,
Lucas Kunce
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50206?refcode=em20240514-5507&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5507%2E614464%2E8CLpOX)**

[](https://www.facebook.com/lucaskuncemo/) | [](https://twitter.com/lucaskuncemo) | [](https://www.instagram.com/lucaskuncemo/)
---|---|---

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you. But, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, [you can do so here](https://act.lucaskunce.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/). If you need to remove yourself from our email list, [click here to unsubscribe](https://act.lucaskunce.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=5507%2E614464%2E8CLpOX). Mail us: PO BOX 1240 Independence, MO 64050.

#

Team -
Today, we hope you’ll allow us to share three reasons as to why your $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC is so important.
1️⃣ **On average, about 120 people die every day from gun violence in our country.** This is a heartbreaking statistic, but it’s one that we CAN change if we continue our work to help pass commonsense gun safety legislation nationwide.
2️⃣ **The election cycle is in full swing.** We’ve made endorsements in state, local, and federal races, and we’ve still got plenty more to come. Our work to win at the ballot box next November is well underway, and we need your support to make sure that gun safety champions defeat extreme gun lobby-backed candidates this November.
3️⃣ **Our May mid-month fundraising drive ends tomorrow at midnight.** Each and every one of our fundraising deadlines is crucial to our ability to continue our lifesaving work. Right now, we’re not quite where we need to be for the month, but if everyone in this community does their part, we’ll be able to reach our goals.
The choice is yours, but we hope that these three reasons demonstrate the importance of your contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.
[**Will you please make a contribution of $3 or more to GIFFORDS PAC today before our mid-month fundraising deadline tomorrow? This is wrong. Ukraine's challenge is not the G.O.P.; it's math. Ukraine needs more soldiers than it can field, even with draconian conscription policies. And it needs more materiel than the United States can provide. This reality must inform any future Ukraine policy, from further congressional aid to the diplomatic course set by the president. The White House has said time and again that it can't negotiate with President Vladimir Putin of Russia. This is absurd. The Biden administration has no viable plan for the Ukrainians to win this war. The sooner Americans confront this truth, the sooner we can fix this mess and broker for peace. [Read Sen. ' THE BIDEN ADMINISTRATION HAS NO VIABLE PLAN FOR THE UKRAINIANS TO WIN THIS WAR SOONER' () - Senator JD Vance penned the below Op-ed: President Biden wants the world to believe that the biggest obstacle facing Ukraine is Republicans and our lack of commitment to the global community. This is wrong. Ukraine's challenge is not the G.O.P.; it's math. Ukraine needs more soldiers than it can field, even with draconian conscription policies. And it needs more materiel than the United States can provide. This reality must inform any future Ukraine policy, from further congressional aid to the diplomatic course set by the president. The White House has said time and again that it can't negotiate with President Vladimir Putin of Russia. This is absurd. The Biden administration has no viable plan for the Ukrainians to win this war. The sooner Americans confront this truth, the sooner we can fix this mess and broker for peace. ' AMERICAN WORKERS STRUGGLE TO FEED THEIR FAMILIES, BUY HOMES AND LIVE THE AMERICAN DREAM... AND BIDEN WANTS TO FLAG WAVE' () -- Ohio Sen. J.D. Vance ripped the Biden administration on Sunday for its celebratory reaction to what appeared to be a blockbuster jobs report released last Friday, showing 303,000 jobs were created during the month of March and unemployment dipped to 3.8%. "While President Biden wants to flag waves about how well the economy's doing... people just don't buy it," Vance claimed during a discussion with Fox News' Maria Bartiromo on "Sunday Morning Futures." ' FOREIGN POLICY IS NOT A NURSERY RHYME - IT SHOULD SERVE AS A WAKE-UP CALL' () -- Sen. JD Vance said Sunday that the U.S. should focus more on itself and its closest allies, such as Israel, instead of sending more aid to Ukraine. "Well, I think foreign policy is not a nursery rhyme, and it should serve as a wake-up call, but it should serve as a wake-up call that we have to rebuild our own industrial base," Vance said. ' I DON'T KNOW WHY JOE BIDEN AND THE DEMOCRATS CAN'T UTTER THE SIMPLE BASIC TRUTH THAT IF YOU VIOLATE THE LAW AND TURN OUR CITIES AND CAMPUSES INTO GARBAGE DUMPS FOR YOUR POLITICAL PROTESTS, YOU NEED TO BE FORCED TO COMPLY WITH THE LAW' (-) - Senator Vance joined Fox News' Jesse Watters to discuss the chaos and violence happening on college campuses. - ' OUR PRESIDENT, INSTEAD OF FOCUSING ON GETTING HOSTAGES BACK, IS FOCUSED ON MICROMANAGING ONE OF OUR ALLIES' WAR EFFORTS () -- Sen. JD Vance (R-Ohio) on Sunday criticized the Biden administration for its tone towards Israel's wartime efforts in Gaza, arguing the U.S. is more focused on "micromanaging" Israel than securing the release of the hostages still held by militant group Hamas. "If you want to get these hostages released, you've got to, first of all, enable Israel to actually finish the job," Vance said in an interview on "Fox News Sunday." "And second of all, put America's diplomatic weight behind and on Hamas, right? Pressure Hamas to release these hostages; don't use America's leverage to effectively cause the Israelis to pull back here." ' WE CANNOT ALLOW ONE OF THE LARGEST AMERICAN STEELMAKERS TO BE GOBBLED UP BY A FOREIGN ENTITY WITH TIES TO THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY' () -- A few Senators from the nation's Rust Belt are sounding the alarm over the ties between the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and the Nippon Steel Corporation -- the Japanese conglomerate looking to purchase the United States Steel Corporation. In December of last year, executives with U.S. Steel and Nippon Steel Corporation announced a nearly $15 billion deal that would have the iconic American steel giant sold off to Japan's largest steelmaker. "We cannot allow one of the largest American steelmakers to be gobbled up by a foreign entity with ties to the Chinese Communist Party and its military-industrial apparatus. The president must find the courage to do what's right and block this deal without delay," Senator Vance said. ' THE CONTRAST COULD NOT BE CLEARER: THE PEOPLE'S PRESIDENT IS TRYING TO RAISE YOUR WAGES AND DELIVER PROSPERITY' () - Senator Vance joined Fox News' Laura Ingraham to discuss the ways Trump delivers for real Americans while Biden policies benefit billionaires. ' WHY ARE REPUBLICANS GIVING THE DEMOCRATS TOOLS TO CONTROL THE TRUMP ADMINISTRATION NEXT YEAR?' () -- A bipartisan proposal to help Ukraine by seizing frozen Russian sovereign assets in the United States and transferring them to Ukraine has run into flak from U.S. Sen. JD Vance, who argues it will backfire by making U.S. Treasuries less attractive to foreign buyers. Vance expressed reservations about the bill during a Senate Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs Committee hearing last week, where he said it "will actually freeze the current sanctions regime that we have on Russia in place legally, as an act of Congress," require congressional removal to change it, and hinder future presidents from negotiating a peaceful settlement to that conflict. Vance also recorded a video, which he posted on social media, that describes the legislation as a way for Democrats in Congress to undermine former President Donald Trump if he's elected president later this year. He called for the legislation to be killed, or at least phased out before the next presidential administration. "Why are Republicans giving the Democrats tools to control the Trump administration next year?" he asks in the video. "It's disgraceful, it's insane and we have the ability to kill it. So let's do it." ' WHY WOULD PEOPLE ELECT REPUBLICANS IF REPUBLICANS ARE MORE FOCUSED ON THE BORDER OF ANOTHER COUNTRY THAN THE BORDER OF OUR OWN COUNTRY?' () -- Republican Ohio Sen. JD Vance pushed Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson to use his leverage in securing border security measures during an interview with Fox News' "Sunday Morning Futures." Vance expressed strong opposition to the GOP-controlled House passing a new foreign aid bill without including border security measures. Vance addressed the expected consideration of foreign aid legislation and urged Johnson not to proceed with a package that would send billions to Ukraine while ignoring the U.S. southern border. "I think Speaker Johnson is a good guy, but if he brings up a foreign aid package, sending billions of dollars to Ukraine, without doing anything on the southern border, it will be a disgrace and a massive betrayal, not just of Republican voters, but of the entire country," Vance said in the Fox News interview. "Why would people elect Republicans if Republicans are more focused on the border of another country than the border of our own country?" name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell (personal email)
subject: In this fight for my kids
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
as a mother — this hits hard.
| | |
---
This is what keeps me up at night, friend: **My three kids are growing up in a state with fewer freedoms than I had at their age. **

You don't need to be a parent to experience the same sinking feeling I get when I think about that. But as a mother — and the daughter of a woman who sought out freedom for her family — it hits hard.
My family lived under a dictatorship in Ecuador where corrupt politicians prevented any true liberty. It's why my mom immigrated our family to the United States when I was just 14, why she worked double shifts as a home health care provider, and why I worked in a doughnut shop to help my family make ends meet. **It's because America was the promise of freedom. The promise of opportunity to _do_ anything and _be_ anything we set our minds to.**
But now, corrupt politicians like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott, are taking away our freedoms instead of protecting them. He is directly responsible for confirming Supreme Court justices that eviscerated reproductive rights. Now, Florida has one of the most extreme abortion bans in the entire nation — a dangerous erosion of liberty my kids are forced to grow up under.
When corrupt politicians like Rick Scott attack one freedom, they never stop there. **That's why I'm running for Senate to stop him.**

I'm in this fight for my kids, for my state of Florida, and to preserve that same promise of liberty that called out to me when I was just a young girl living under a dictatorship. **With polling showing me _ahead_ of Rick Scott right now, I know we can win this — but I need your help to do it, friend.**

| Asking for money is my least favorite part of running for office.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2610%2E35263%2Ewxa-BT)
Peter — To be honest, asking for money is my least favorite part of the job. But unless I can start cutting my campaign seven-figure checks like my opponent is doing — _hint: I cannot!_ — grassroots fundraising is absolutely necessary if we want to stay competitive in this race. | | | Peter - My name is Linnea Saltz. I am Drew's campaign manager. I'm also the first woman ever to sue the NCAA because I was forced to compete against a biological male.

Last month, the Biden administration did what I always considered unthinkable, rewriting Title IX to redefine sex discrimination to include “gender identity." What this means is that **what happened to me in 2020 will continue to happen to women all across the country. **

Back in 2020, when I was competing on Southern Utah University's track and field team, **I was forced to compete against the first ever male-to-female transgender athlete in NCAA Division I.** An individual who was born a male and competed as a male for 3 years at the University of Montana was identifying as a female and set to compete against me and my teammates.

As the defending Big Sky Conference Champion in the 800m, with a personal best time of 2 minutes and 5 seconds, it was unbelievable to me that the NCAA would allow a male athlete who ran this race in 1 minute and 55 seconds (a world record time for women) to toe the line with the rest of the female athletes working tirelessly to win a prestigious conference title.

This started my advocacy for keeping women's sports women-only. From speaking on the main stage at [CPAC](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=15ab78311f&e=fc26432468) to being featured on national news outlets such as[ ](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=169aa70ecf&e=fc26432468)[Fox ](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=f8dd6a901b&e=fc26432468)[News](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=db2f33d585&e=fc26432468), I've fought to protect women's sports and keep men out of women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and dorms. And **now I am fighting alongside Drew.** When Drew first heard my story, he was motivated to become an advocate for people like me and an ally for women's rights when he is elected this November. **That is why friends and advocacy partners, including Riley Gaines, have come out in support of electing Drew to Congress.**

**I am proud to work for someone like Drew, who will advance women's rights, continue to fight for women, and ensure that women's spaces are for women only. **

| | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=da4ac60ccee941b9a8b925d7105e459d&_e=t7FFhLEwdS0SO-ys3Qc9Y9xuMIDGB_0h3SqcsoIU5hGwXogaEPdnWizORtzMI0M962ysFJtRFDIx9YS49RwffyJv0z3g6iphDiHySpr39WJAD4HeeaqZVVWVWOKZt7z42_gmo6DscLYmveXipJGFX9bhezzBgu6dcTu7c1w091DrRXhvk-6l32IaB6o95N3t_YTjRwlLe435qjlbUmpE5uaic4DOa5jlc391kBX4FeIa4wvnMEeme7_MmWNG52hCUlzRtOPcfkWlkESQoFM2C56Xxt3qFKBXV0-YSpykBqklLOvSB0C-eemQyp9OruV5D3dZsa1Rg0LK_RXPfBvAzUCdgNW5GCq9_bUIMCROEglnYOHZbYPyCWxuvXIL3ycz-4fa384QVOP9S6urCsVx6g%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=da4ac60ccee941b9a8b925d7105e459d&_e=t7FFhLEwdS0SO-ys3Qc9Y9xuMIDGB_0h3SqcsoIU5hGwXogaEPdnWizORtzMI0M962ysFJtRFDIx9YS49RwffyJv0z3g6iphDiHySpr39WJAD4HeeaqZVVWVWOKZt7z42_gmo6DscLYmveXipJGFX9bhezzBgu6dcTu7c1w091DrRXhvk-6l32IaB6o95N3t_YTjRwlLe435qjlbUmpE5uaic4DOa5jlc391kBX4FeKFEfv_kyToOCnn7HwFMRdEYehuUGSZJqU20RZ7dGJGBrGISVXudJqHc2f6k8M-B--HsFtoDkHz3NXqNg7-t_GZU6_wJPiztCe3A181LbKIJ7tVVHuoX4VhR5erWmQOQG9jo-d67gA-nVECJ9corRYAaqKIGpkEWgNaw9i-LnehZg%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. Fellow American,
[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=8e1c7472b5064e60b7d3576af0297b12&_e=QUlFRCVsVfQxvMl_CIExDJVa1Fgd8F4uzLTpOttSPZcdhLMZar-ZGVlHK47_BIpZw3nNWNt0RjvCz0luceu53gAX_F1zbIYthXgcfcS5COjPIQqXyNsihi6UG7cz6GFjpt2HuRbAfyCtUhXD0TBUT82DiRNeBDjqeokYYK2HQrTf6S2wUmtEmFB_-zlwlOm6WobfTB_ACnvZ4mZ74BW7jlQSntDfaBbh6PjX9WtoBGV7iQokrBj7tqAV5oQNsgs5ZVMbdNHOvwBs7Eh_hrNpaItL4-wfV3KUB1cmC6ColBdyREGUpQ3OCH-PMgbWgE9zePtDJFmX6BT-MBrr7gn4kKTybuyK4BblosvJPK98uWZ2JAgzHWsBk4ovFUsIldL7)
_Wesley Hunt here._

As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I’m running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.
[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=8e1c7472b5064e60b7d3576af0297b12&_e=QUlFRCVsVfQxvMl_CIExDJVa1Fgd8F4uzLTpOttSPZcdhLMZar-ZGVlHK47_BIpZw3nNWNt0RjvCz0luceu53gAX_F1zbIYthXgcfcS5COjPIQqXyNsihi6UG7cz6GFjpt2HuRbAfyCtUhXD0TBUT82DiRNeBDjqeokYYK2HQrTf6S2wUmtEmFB_-zlwlOm6WobfTB_ACnvZ4mZ74BW7jlQSntDfaBbh6PjX9WtoBGVLBtr0hbOq2TeOZ97uZ0xwPUqyUKDSCfiSwrkGjLFR8TD09hI5jkIDWvax2tr8LF8twaEDF0KR3Yvoi4rqaao6ACVp2R6zk7IIwxg3PfSWDHGhCYsBlt9qmW3fpQ3cXHoTxyrLaoS4KfPLeySQyXhX) _
(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress.

| | Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=56a279eda238418e992cef139d595833&_e=2qb54crsTuNhoZVCKvpww9Pvk5ubJoE7ZCgdgOp0A1kyEujn2jvcIec8EVnNaegllKyy9fov9F7zaBc6S-Rhtzbgt4nb5lS77KN42qCRBenn5ZnRH__DWwa6GaXBmTPZfjZPjZyqyoVqSLaT6DDUqfM_aDFC3Tncsi9wYaCFoLEKRGkCIZRQT2jXCwu4yVXQMbDv0aqt9wP0LoCt6cX18Eq01N1gflWbXwANqDrxCVJbCj7w-QLBJSJpKbMb8nvKABhOux9w1i1_lsdz3m7R4mgH8F4BndUxivJaKPYB0hL0MyRot9IlweH_UYzLZuaJyQXoFAupuyXd9hikP3viFxzLBkZ9JT71UMKbj26vON4LzDIZm0cCwiV0YCZBF5F5NiaynIDA-4KkjFU1jJh60A%3D%3D)

| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That's why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=56a279eda238418e992cef139d595833&_e=2qb54crsTuNhoZVCKvpww9Pvk5ubJoE7ZCgdgOp0A1kyEujn2jvcIec8EVnNaegllKyy9fov9F7zaBc6S-Rhtzbgt4nb5lS77KN42qCRBenn5ZnRH__DWwa6GaXBmTPZfjZPjZyqyoVqSLaT6DDUqfM_aDFC3Tncsi9wYaCFoLEKRGkCIZRQT2jXCwu4yVXQMbDv0aqt9wP0LoCt6cX18Eq01N1gflWbXwANqDrxCVKLd-Jdsi00Y0diDWQ9TIcnKX2hk5T8Gy28rlLlWHYJfnU2oOE1pABhxgUD_LeYHgbYhn0rvmfZAQYNtfSuWzBvnLpTI5bXbcqwxNOBKtOsuTJS7ecYenac0IaRosoq5X2reP-OHxR6CesXeqWkI07OjFdw24dhXonfiqKVwyKqmA%3D%3D)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you'll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment--and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

# The Man We're Tired of Hating
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/3magasenators?refcode=ad)
---
| Look, we hate Ted Cruz. Ever since his starring role in the 2013 government shutdown, Cruz proved himself willing to blackmail the Democrats and the American people, leveraging the**continued functioning of government**. And though he won the minds of many Republicans, he hardly won their hearts. Hating Ted Cruz has been a much-needed source of bipartisanship in our legislature over the years. Matt Dowd, chief strategist for the Bush-Cheney campaign, stated that _**“to know Ted Cruz is to dislike Ted Cruz”**_ , while Al Franken said, _**“I like Cruz more than most, and I hate him.”**_ Cruz has embraced this “maverick” persona, paving the way for an entirely less civil mode of American politics. This year may be our best shot to unseat Cruz. **Texans have literally created an urban legend around his appearance at recent Astros baseball games, blaming his presence for the team’s bad performance, and begging the senator to stay home.** Recent polls have Cruz leading only by single digits, and Colin Allred has put together a strong campaign in Texas. While there is a great satisfaction in thinking of Ted Cruz unseated, it also speaks to a worrying trend in the Republican party. _**The new generation of Ted Cruzes are so much better at being hated, at not caring whether they break our government.**__**The Josh Hawleys and Matt Gaetzs of the world are waiting in the wings. They have entirely dispensed with party loyalty in favor of petty one-upmanship.**_ The rot forming within the Republican party, which pushes outwards until it corrodes the very institutions it is meant to service, is incredibly dangerous at this fraught moment in global politics. The stakes for unseating Republican radicals has never been higher. But one thing is clear. **This may be the end of Ted Cruz****,** and it would be a big relief. We're tired of hating one guy _so_ much. body:
Judicial Watch announced recently that it filed a lawsuit to force California to clean up its voter rolls. The lawsuit, filed on behalf of Judicial Watch and the Libertarian Party of California, asks the court to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as required by federal law.

subject: If you disagree with the book bans sweeping our nation, endorse my Book Save Lives Act
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE COMMITTEE TO ELECT AYANNA PRESSLEY
body:
| | | | |
---
| | | | | | Friends, An estimated 3,300+ books were banned in the 2022-2023 school year, a 33% increase from the previous school year. In Massachusetts alone, we’ve witnessed the number of book challenges quadruple since 2021. To no one’s surprise, these bans overwhelmingly target books about race and racism, as well as books with LGBTQ+ characters, and they are part of coordinated Republican efforts to erase and whitewash history, to bury America’s violent legacy of racial injustice, and to further marginalize people who already face discrimination in our society. **[I’ve introduced legislation to stop extremist Republicans and far-right groups from censoring books in our libraries and schools: The Books Save Lives Act. Add your name if you agree: We have the duty to protect our history and our stories for future generations, and extremists don’t have the final say in what our children read.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc0dc11f8-ac29-45cc-bf6c-2d65a83febab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
| | | | [ADD YOUR NAME >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tceba16e9-bfbe-43ed-a415-367f5beb0ec3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | The Books Save Lives Act would:
* **Classify** discriminatory book bans as violations of federal civil rights laws;
* **Require** public libraries and school libraries to maintain a diverse collection of books;
* **Ensure** primary and secondary schools have a library with a trained librarian; and
* **Direct** the Government Accountability Office to report on the effect of book bans on underrepresented communities

Everyone has a right to read, learn, and see themselves and their lived experience reflected in our literature. I have always talked about the importance of honoring the brilliance and diversity of our authors and librarians. They are the ones who are advocating for the continued representation of our communities in our books and the freedom to pursue boundless knowledge. The threat of book bans across the country — and the need for accessible, representative literature — is greater than ever. [**Please**, if you agree that every reader has a right to **free access to information and public education, where they can be greeted by books that reflect the diversity of lived experiences in their neighborhoods and around the world, add your name to become a grassroots co-sponsor of the Books Save Lives Act.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T439d85ab-993d-42de-a9dc-6f89eab735dd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

When Madison visited the Southern Border earlier this year, she didn’t go to rack up likes on Instagram or rant about it on X. Madison learned about everything from trade between Mexico and the U.S., to what our border patrol agents need to secure our border - here’s what she learned .
This is a zero-sum game , while we’ve been bickering with each other, China's been moving in and setting up shop in Mexico.
Our immigration system? It needs a complete overhaul - the last time it was updated, the internet was just getting started.
Bice and the rest of her colleagues can’t seem to understand that, or they don’t care to. Which is worse?
So, here’s where you come in. Madison’s got plans, but t hey don’t mean a thing without your help.
We need to unseat Bice so we can start working on solutions - she’s one of the biggest roadblocks in Congress for effective immigration policy. But we can't do that without your support.... [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mail-border-may]

_Wesley Hunt here._

As we head into another election year, I want to ensure that the generous people supporting my reelection know why I'm running.

I was born and raised in Houston, Texas.

After graduating from high school, I felt the call to serve our nation in the military, like my father and sister before me, and I accepted an appointment to the United States Military Academy at West Point.
[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=ba99edc6d5fb4242a23f0f6bcae21c2f&_e=31Be2VLZdFvG8TdQDKP_rsWNFrVJqsyqn8ZbA1DMKfkeizcoaNzs4L3gvvsbudGWJWTL7_uoPOaXq2tbj8qeWcRrwHTMRDPykOyLTxQAhVexkaEkrcdrl-YOumPLbEV4d_Ec0ptpYNRY8MYDgCRASdz2TurgotWHiLyeEva_HV49qeTcCP8VY7dqO2Htkkf1mM5Mnj4USwQA-rGLradVORJysBNAGUu3PgO3Wo6vFMqDqXLcMJpEJzEz5wqqdM4XUQB5rFPJzj0CWAZ_wO2Wts3RJnTK6rV_oF-GfcUA8so%3D)_
(Me with my brother and sister, who also attended West Point)_
My service included one combat deployment to Iraq and two to Saudi Arabia, where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer. While in Saudi Arabia, I represented the U.S. government in missions involving the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Corps.

After completing my military service, I attended Cornell University, where I earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.), and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never thought I would get involved in politics, but after seeing the dysfunction and destruction wrought by liberal elites in the Democrat party, I was once again called to serve our great nation, by running for the United States Congress.

I knew that challenging the DC Washington elite wouldn't be easy, but after flying Apache helicopters over Iraq, I knew I was prepared to take on the tough fights.

****Join me in the fight to save the future of America.****

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=ba99edc6d5fb4242a23f0f6bcae21c2f&_e=31Be2VLZdFvG8TdQDKP_rsWNFrVJqsyqn8ZbA1DMKfkeizcoaNzs4L3gvvsbudGWJWTL7_uoPOaXq2tbj8qeWcRrwHTMRDPykOyLTxQAhVexkaEkrcdrl-YOumPLbEV4d_Ec0ptpYNRY8MYDgCRASYMAgC9w9xKKKP1rkNL-aJZn1DOzfmeS6QOIGxv34BcNqzLlrV1Ql9Zr3HvMpOgnfs6nIGcHWs4uC8EXstGXX3kEf1v8ycnlKnhjsn8DQDdbPY_ijVqVLDX8V13bXa0dVFirR_GeQcWwf4j-_-2m-aw%3D)
**This picture** is my number one reason for serving Texans in Congress. Being a husband and a father has taught me selflessness and dedication and has instilled in me a desire to better our country for the next generation.

Now, here we are in one of the most consequential election years of our lifetime. The majority we fought so hard for in 2022 hangs in the balance, and conservative ideals are under fire every day.

We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. | Dear Fellow Patriot,

It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.

And if you agree with me, then I invite you to use the link below to sign the pledge today.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f1602f0da65840a38f87be70e1824e3c&_e=PiT3GrSMua1dvo9PDkBV746gfaDLh3_ZPADe2ZHilPbyjo-742pqhjBr9ydJteKBqvv3uBnJ92ATyNvsy8G3iCrA2LsfrHQyeUIjIUVzY43EcnWK6LV28IuA_dtIjg2v_IYJE5QVdhiM-yolXfyuz99kS7OhNag7kTaZzbijtQ0AfW6NU4FXYeD8NqQCAym-4M-4T1Hwa-aBNgFYhdDIQHOSsM1u0v-SNkMm2WHxbCol6plqd0_eDp8yCkqvX4ShUrG57oTgZUs0uVeNlVN1jKb_UySVuOsIQLo6mSn7P88FD-a8kC6ZYICNLT0rgBWnwDz9d2i8BXr_aMg5jFXnAWdC_u41yjy9123bGhLZFXiDBtI_l3tdcF3ZlsSJoVRPWCo7hc_YRcDODFGSzkukATEfyUShLAljCKV4_NVnLXo%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

And we need your help to make the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available free of charge so that it will have the greatest impact. We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other outreach efforts--including Imprimis , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 .

I’m unsure if you’re aware, but tomorrow marks the final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of Montana’s June 4th primary. And quite frankly, I hoped to be in a better spot.

Why?

Because getting dollars in the door this month has been tough. My finance team tells me it’s typical for fundraising to begin taking off as Election Day draws nearer, but that hasn’t happened for us. For a while, things seem to be sorting themselves out. We raised a decent amount of money in March and April, but once May rolled around, our numbers went downhill.

Friends,
In just a minute, we are going to ask you to contribute $3 — or whatever you can afford — to our movement, but first, we need you to understand the power of your $3:
If everyone reading this email chipped in $3 today, we could:
1. Continue to support Senators Tammy Baldwin and Jon Tester in their vulnerable re-election campaigns.

2. Fight to unseat extremist Republicans like Ted Cruz who poses a threat to our fundamental democratic freedoms and elect lawmakers who will fight for American families.

4. Have the financial resources to continue our pro-democracy movement.

# AI Policy Impact Forum
Presented by ARI
[RSVP Here](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=0d987b78ce&e=a07d75591f)
Join Americans for Responsible Innovation (ARI) for an AI Policy Impact Forum on Capitol Hill to explore how the U.S. can responsibly harness the power of AI to serve the public interest.

Featuring conversations with **Senator Todd Young, Senator Joni Ernst, Congressman Don Beyer, Congressman Ted Lieu, Congressman Jim Himes** , and other leading U.S. officials at the forefront of the issue, the event will explore the most pressing AI challenges facing policymakers today.
**LOCATION** U.S. Capitol Visitor Center
First St SE, Washington, DC 20515
Rooms SVC 208 & 209
**DATE & TIME**May 22, 2024
3:00 - 5:00 PM
New AI capabilities are expanding at a rapid pace, and the U.S. risks falling behind on addressing the current harms, emerging risks, and national security challenges posed by this breakthrough technology. How lawmakers meet this moment — and whether they can develop and implement a thoughtful governance framework that protects Americans from harm while continuing to foster our innovative edge — will determine the future of the AI policy landscape.

ARI is bringing together leading AI technology experts and U.S. policymakers for an AI Policy Impact Forum on Capitol Hill to answer these questions and chart the path forward on harnessing the power of this technology to serve the public interest. The event will include a reception.
**Join us on May 22** _We look forward to hosting you!_
Sincerely,Brad Carson & Eric GastfriendCo-Founders, Americans for Responsible Innovation

| | | A recent investigation revealed that Trump may owe the IRS $100 million in back taxes – plus interest and penalties! Trump has been the focus of a years-long inquiry by the IRS for "a [dubious accounting maneuver](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tac346511-9944-4479-93f3-9ede8fc6758c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that effectively meant taking the same write-offs twice on a Chicago skyscraper." In 2008, Trump claimed losses of $651 million for his Trump International Hotel and Tower in Chicago. He then transferred the ownership of the property to a different holding company that he also controlled in 2010, and reported an additional $168 million in losses over the next decade, double-dipping on tax losses. This is just another example in a long list of Trump's lies and deceit. He has intentionally skirted tax laws to benefit himself at the expense of the American people. He should be penalized and charged the full amount he owes. Hi Peter,

I’ve always thought that we achieve the best policy results when both sides of the aisle come together in good faith to work on legislation. **I believe in building consensus whenever possible, and not listening to the extreme fringes who treat compromise like a dirty word.** But here’s the thing: today’s MAGA Republicans are more interested in electing Donald Trump than actually getting stuff done. This is too important for me to not alert you. The King County Council is voting _this week_ on yet another radical agenda item that will hurt everyday workers and businesses in King County. This time, they're trying to push through an extreme minimum wage increase that is guaranteed to cripple small businesses in King County.

This new extreme law would make rural communities in unincorporated King County tied with just one other city for the highest minimum wage in the nation. But the legislation doesn't include critical small business protections that even the city of Seattle utilizes ensure businesses are not forced to go out of business.

Yes, you read that correctly - **The King County Council is trying to force a minimum wage law on rural King County that __even Seattle__ deemed too extreme and damaging to businesses to put into effect when they passed their minimum wage legislation.**

_[We must stop this, before it's too late! Can you chip in $15, $25, or $50 today to help me protect businesses in King County?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=465b0a7298&e=77eef70c61)_

_Do you agree with me that residents of rural King County should**NOT** have their businesses and livelihoods destroyed just so that far left Seattle politicians can brag to their activist base?_ If so, you can help me stop it by donating [HERE](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=c842808f86&e=77eef70c61).

name: Supervisor David Canepa
subject: 2024 May e-newsletter
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
# 2024 May e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Beyond Differences offers curriculum for schools for youth suffering loneliness**
---
| Dear friends,

I was so honored to be invited as a guest speaker and to share the stage with Congresswoman-elect Lateefah Simon at the Beyond Differences fundraiser at Sweetwater in Mill Valley, Saturday, May 4.

I was particularly touched by the story of Lili, the daughter of Beyond Differences’ founders Laura Talmus and Ace Smith, who suffered social isolation for no reason other than she looked different. Lili was born with Apert Syndrome, a rare cranial-facial anomaly, which caused her peers and teachers to treat her differently than other students.

She was not bullied or teased but was often treated as if she were invisible. This behavior was just as insidious. Social isolation was not recognized as a serious public health issue at the time, which amplified Lili’s pain and loneliness.
---
Lili and her family believed that Apert Syndrome–or any difference for that matter – should never prevent young people from forming deep and meaningful relationships.

Sadly, in October 2009, Lili passed away unexpectedly in her sleep due to medical complications. She was only 151⁄2 years old.

Since San Mateo County was the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis, I have learned so much about the epidemic and its impacts on our youth, older adults and everyone in between.

I could tell how impactful Beyond Differences curriculum is as I listened to Avery, Briggs and Jacky (shown in the picture above) share the experiences they’ve had and the projects and presentations they’ve made to raise awareness of social isolation and loneliness. To learn more go to: [https://www.beyonddifferences.org/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a66c01452b&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **Bay Wheels bikeshare station debuts in San Mateo County**

May is National Bike month and I’m proud to announce that the Metropolitan Transportation Commission in partnership with Lyft has launched the first Bay Wheels bikeshare station in San Mateo County at the Daly City BART station.

This station paves the way for safer bicycling and its debut at Daly City BART, the ninth busiest in the system, can propel the Bay Area to be the most bike-friendly in the nation one day.

It’s a last-mile commute solution that is better for the environment and better for the mind and body. Today, Amsterdam is considered to be the most bike-friendly in the entire world but it was only a few decades ago that the city’s streets were clogged with cars like we are now. I’m proud to be a part of a growing movement that shows what a little pedal power can do.

The new docking station marks the first Bay Wheels location in San Mateo County and the continuation of a growth strategy that began last fall with the introduction of more than 1,500 new e-bikes and 30 new docking stations in San Francisco and San Jose and then shifted last month to the East Bay, where the system is adding 24 new docking stations and 565 next-generation e-bikes in Oakland, Emeryville and Berkeley.

Launched in 2017, Bay Wheels is the Bay Area’s regional bikeshare program with over 6,000 bicycles — both pedal-powered and pedal-assist electric bikes — at more than 500 stations in San Jose, San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville and Daly City. Lyft operates Bay Wheels under a contract managed by MTC.

To learn more go to: [https://mtc.ca.gov/operations/traveler-services/bay-wheels-bike-share-program](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=807389001e&e=c0babbc643)
---
---
| **Skyline Learning Communities celebrates $125,000 grant from my office**

It was nearly a year ago on May 23, 2023, that the Board of Supervisors approved my district discretionary Measure K request of $125,000 to benefit Skyline College’s Learning Communities, which honored me for the contribution Thursday, May 9.

Skyline’s learning communities such as UMOJA (African American), Puente (Latinx), Black and Brown Scholars, Women’s Leadership and Mentoring Academy (WMLA), Kababayan (Fliipinx), and First Year Experience (FYE) among others provide a supportive network of culturally competent faculty, staff, and administrators to help you reach your goals.

These are frankly programs that did not exist when I attended Skyline back in the early 90s.
It shows you how we are growing as a community to uplift all voices in this county, to provide an education and a pathway to a four-year-degree or a career in the trades.

The Measure K showcase held on campus is proof as I learn more about the learning community and affinity group projects that when government invests in culturally-competent education the results can be limitless.
---
| **New shuttle for Veterans Village in Colma prompted by outreach from 2 commissions**

May is Older Americans Month and I want to highlight and praise two county commissions, the Commission on Aging and the Veterans Commission, that prompted President Warren Slocum and I to fund startup costs of $26,000 for a new shuttle route that will serve the 70 residents who live at the Colma Veterans Village.

Last year, the two commissions came to us and recommended that the veterans who live at Colma Veterans Village needed better access to public transportation. The option available to these veterans, many with mobility issues, was the SamTrans bus service with bus stops in either direction over a half mile away.

At first, we were told that there was not a solution. We asked the transportation agency representatives to go back to the drawing table and find one for their veterans. And they did.

President Slocum and I met with officials from SamTrans, the City of South San Francisco and the Town of Colma over the ensuing months, and a solution for the veterans at Colma Veterans Village was found.

The City of South San Francisco already has free shuttle service in and around South San Francisco, which is funded through the City and a grant from SamTrans.

They agreed to expand shuttle service to and from Colma Veterans Village and the town of Colma agreed to assist with the funding, through June 2025 (when the next application to continue the South San Francisco Shuttle would occur).

After surveying the residents of Colma Veterans Village, a route has been established that will be free of charge and allow them to transfer to other routes within South San Francisco. The exciting news is that this route will begin operations at the end of May or in early June 2024.

This district-discretionary grant will enable South San Francisco, in collaboration with the town of Colma, to engage in outreach to expand free shuttle services to Colma Veterans Village, allowing the veteran residents ease of travel within Colma and South San Francisco. It will also allow for a special Memorial Day Shuttle to and from Colma Veterans Village to take the residents to the Memorial Day services at Golden Gate National Cemetery in San Bruno.

All said and done, this is great news for our veterans and we thank SamTrans and its CEO April Chan, the city of South San Francisco and its City Manager Sharon Ranals and the Town of Colma for this positive collaboration.

---
|
**May is Mental Health Month**

Each year, San Mateo County joins our state and country in celebrating Mental Health Month (MHM) in May. MHM is one of the best times of the year to increase awareness and inspire action to reduce stigma against those with mental health and substance use conditions. Each year the county partners with local agencies and community members to promote events free and open to the public throughout the county.

I am excited to share that the theme for 2024 May Mental Health Month is “Heal Through Connection #SMCAgainstLoneliness.”

The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors passed a resolution in January I sponsored declaring loneliness a public health crisis and pledging to promote social connection in our communities. According to the 2023 San Mateo County Health and Quality of Life Survey, 45% of residents in San Mateo County were experiencing difficulty with loneliness and isolation.

Now more than ever it is important that we find ways to connect with one another. This May, we encourage folks to connect with others at one of our free public events, connect to resources and connect with your community by getting involved.

I’d like to thank Mental Health Month Planning Committee co-Chairs Kristie Lui and Sylvia Tang for orchestrating a series of events this month to that brings our community together to engage in meaningful connectivity.

To learn more click here: [https://www.smchealth.org/mental-health-month](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=b65fe19d8b&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e43ca019cf&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org)
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=d746395175&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f095e895ac&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=46adf5aca5&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship,
David J. Canepa

This May, we encourage folks to connect with others at one of our free public events, connect to resources and connect with your community by getting involved. I’d like to thank Mental Health Month Planning Committee co-Chairs Kristie Lui and Sylvia Tang for orchestrating a series of events this month to that brings our community together to engage in meaningful connectivity. To learn more click here: | Interns wanted to join our team We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: . You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org | Battling food insecurity Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: CalFresh: Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: Contact: (650) 802-6576, mailto:antorres@smcgov.org Daly City Partnership: DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: Second Harvest Food Bank: Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship, David J. Canepa | | | | | | | Copyright © 2024 Supervisor David Canepa, All rights reserved.

What I wore to work every day? No choice. Where I would live? No choice. Who my boss was? No choice. **But one choice I always had? My reproductive healthcare.**
That's a choice Brian Fitzpatrick voted to take away from women in the military last summer.
See, after the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, the Pentagon set a policy to pay for travel to access reproductive healthcare if a service member lives in a state that bans abortion. Fitzpatrick joined with the majority of Republicans last summer to try and overturn that policy. (Luckily, they failed.)
Service members choose to risk our lives for this country. What we don't choose is whether we live in a state that bans abortion or protects it.
And what angers me even more? It's only going to get worse.
Because not only are Fitzpatrick and his fellow Republicans going to continue to go after service members' abortion freedom – Speaker Mike Johnson has made it clear he wants a national abortion ban.

No choice. Where I would live? No choice. Who my boss was? No choice. But one choice I always had? My reproductive healthcare. That's a choice Brian Fitzpatrick voted to take away from women in the military last summer. See, after the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, the Pentagon set a policy to pay for travel to access reproductive healthcare if a service member lives in a state that bans abortion. Fitzpatrick joined with the majority of Republicans last summer to try and overturn that policy. (Luckily, they failed.) Service members choose to risk our lives for this country. What we don't choose is whether we live in a state that bans abortion or protects it. And what angers me even more? It's only going to get worse. _** **_ Fellow Conservative,

I’m unsure if you’re aware, but tomorrow marks the final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of Montana’s June 4th primary. And quite frankly, I hoped to be in a better spot.

Why?

Because getting dollars in the door this month has been tough. My finance team tells me it’s typical for fundraising to begin taking off as Election Day draws nearer, but that hasn’t happened for us. For a while, things seem to be sorting themselves out. We raised a decent amount of money in March and April, but once May rolled around, our numbers went downhill.

**But don’t take my word for it. I made the chart above to show how dramatically our fundraising has fallen off.**
[**CHIP IN $3 ->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=afa4e994a8724ac0b0954634ed23186d&_e=YMN_nLdbehqGXFDD2bFA_B4_RQgcflF8AraB0AWPWJKiJwTtAC95Z6pX1UFIjr-nNSPu3WtvFH_noFGiwPr0BZLFy8R32un_3Uoej4gJzo46jnwv65Bubzq10cFOa_zVl_mt0VuMX0vnWW2Om3aCEzkw73EATMHs-n5iA3UZgG2iWaM3BwhWVt_NK2BYAWWhHRya6i70Dl71KjpEigJBqSv_7c-atNyrMiDZr8ISKEZMwDLYtuDJe7-XuRfSKZfpPj_eVZS6QynzaXI5cfTX3cXwytLYOCpNPVoI0XxzScgLPuDuQ67Sas1r8RTY3vA2kyDQQpCstwj0D7qYUuOnNarhRcMlZrEopcs7Hs-8f-e1624RY50y6DCpN5MS2TCmCQG50RLHyQUjBjDATI972A%3D%3D)
Each value in the chart above represents how much my team raised in the first 15 days of each month so far in 2024.

Things were on the up and up through March , then we began to slide backward.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

* When we missed our April fundraising goal, I emailed our list of supporters, explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1 and is regularly outraised by my opponent five to one. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say say that request fell short is an understatement. **My plea for help raised just $931. ->[link to donate](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=afa4e994a8724ac0b0954634ed23186d&_e=YMN_nLdbehqGXFDD2bFA_B4_RQgcflF8AraB0AWPWJKiJwTtAC95Z6pX1UFIjr-nNSPu3WtvFH_noFGiwPr0BZLFy8R32un_3Uoej4gJzo46jnwv65Bubzq10cFOa_zVl_mt0VuMX0vnWW2Om3aCEzkw73EATMHs-n5iA3UZgG2iWaM3BwhWVt_NK2BYAWWhHRya6i70Dl71KjpEigJBqSv_7c-atNyrMiDZr8ISKEZMwDLYtuDJe7-XuRfSKZfpaIsBbjsFVe6exXRLZPOjW2mrMiFSc_R0o-xUXHyLcAETs2VHL8LwwuH8L5A5dSKJiUPy85k7dumwb7agOXsHxVEviQGi4HdxQuNXAi74kAJ2SfFjr1NrkwidktM2QOWgj3rD9INQp9yTdezwFb52HA%3D%3D) **

* We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

* Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. clean_body: | | Friend, last night, it was my honor to accept the Democratic nomination for Connecticut’s 5th congressional district on the November ballot. Serving as your representative in Congress is a responsibility that I do not take lightly. Particularly in such politically polarizing times, I have always led with a firm commitment to my values while being willing to work in a bipartisan manner to affect real, positive change and always to listen. There are powerful special interests in this country who wish to replace me with a rubber stamp for the MAGA agenda in my opponent George Logan. Just days before our district convention, the Koch brothers-affiliated group Americans for Prosperity began running negative advertising against me in our district. = | = Monthly donations are the most impactful form of support our campaign receives — allowing us to hire and train staff and volunteers, invest in voter contact, and do the hard work of turning out voters in November. Peter,
In this photo from 10 years ago, we were ousting the author of SB 1070 and fighting it at the courts. We won in the courts and at the ballot box. Now, more than a decade later, Republicans are trying to bring that hateful bill back from the dead as HCR 2060.

We stayed in Arizona and have fought for our state to be different, for our state to be welcoming — we don't give up.
Here we are, once again, fighting extremist policies around immigration. The right is politicizing and fear-mongering towards immigrant, Latino, and other communities of color.
MAGA Republicans in our state legislature lost the fight to take away our reproductive freedom, so now they’re trying to take away the freedoms of immigrants — or people who they think look like immigrants.
We all know it: we need to reform our immigration system. That’s part of why I’m running for Congress. It breaks my heart that the next generation now has to fight the same attacks we won at the courts and the ballot box against SB 1070.
Now is not the time to take the foot off the pedal. This can be stopped. Juntos, sí se puede.
In solidarity,
Raquel Terán

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The climate crisis is upon us. 2023 was the hottest year on record, and extreme weather events cost the U.S. trillions of dollars. Human health, food security, and global displacement are all at stake.

While President Biden and Congress have taken steps to address the crisis, we need immediate action to avoid catastrophe.

President Biden must declare a climate emergency under the National Emergencies Act. This will allow us to:

• Reinstate the crude oil export ban.
• End new fossil fuel projects and drilling.
• Invest disaster relief funds in renewable energy for frontline communities.
• Push companies to accelerate clean energy solutions.

Tell President Biden: Declare a climate emergency under the National Emergencies Act. I’m worried, Peter.
**[My finance director just texted me saying we’re falling behind on our fundraising – so before I go any further, I need to ask for your help. Will you pitch in $5 or more right now to help us stay on track?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240514-2&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA)**
This couldn’t have come at a worse time. A billionaire-funded super PAC just launched a $4 million ad buy to blanket Pennsylvania’s airwaves, and back-to-back polls show this race is tightening.
With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, we need to close this gap in our fundraising – but unlike my hedge fund executive opponent, I don’t have millions upon millions of dollars to fund this campaign. That means I’m relying on your support more than ever to help us turn things around.
**[Can I count on you to chip in $5 or more before our mid-quarter deadline tomorrow night? Your contribution today could help make the difference between a red and blue Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240514-2&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA)**
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._
[Donate $15 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&amount=15&refcode=em20240514-2-el&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA) [Donate $25 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&amount=25&refcode=em20240514-2-el&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA) [Donate $50 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&amount=50&refcode=em20240514-2-el&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA) [Donate $100 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&amount=100&refcode=em20240514-2-el&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA) [Donate $250 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&amount=250&refcode=em20240514-2-el&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA) [Other amount ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240514-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240514-2&refcode2=2964_552475_9T1xeA&akid=2964%2E552475%2E9T1xeA)

Peter,
“A Tucson congressman who helped supervise the appointment of five anti-abortion justices to the Arizona Supreme Court now appears to be a victim of his own success...”
We didn’t write this — but we couldn’t agree more.
This is the first line in a new article in The Copper Courier that unpacks Juan Ciscomani’s connection to anti-abortion laws in Arizona [https://coppercourier.com/2024/05/09/ciscomani-arizona-supreme-court-abortion/] .

(And if not, that’s OK, too.) So, here are the five biggest reasons I’m asking for your support today. **1) This is one of just a handful of congressional districts that will decide control of the House.** In 2022, this race was so close that we went to sleep on Election Night not knowing for sure whether we’d won or lost. And I accept that we’ll probably be in that situation again this November. You know what I’m not OK with though? Going to sleep not knowing that we did everything we possibly could to win every single vote. **2) If we win, we’ve got a real shot at protecting abortion rights in all 50 states.** We’re just FOUR seats away from a pro-choice Democratic majority in the House — as long as we hold battleground seats like this one. So when you donate, you are increasing our chances that we can pass a federal law guaranteeing every woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions. **3) Far-right super PACs are targeting this seat.** They’ve said publicly that defeating me is a top priority — because they know as well as I do that their path to implementing their MAGA agenda runs right through OR-06. **4) My record shows I deliver results.** Here in Oregon, I helped pass one of the most ambitious abortion-rights laws in the nation. And in Congress, I’m one of the only first-term Democrats to pass a law through the GOP majority — and I’ve also delivered critical funding to help families in our district. **5) Our May fundraising - very simply - needs to improve.** Going into tomorrow’s mid-month deadline, we’re short of our projections — and, on a grassroots campaign like ours, that means the response we get to emails like this really matters. Every single person who reads this and takes action by donating just $5 is helping us get back on track. # **VETERAN CONGRESSMAN TOM COLE'S ATTACK ON BUSINESSMAN RIVAL BOOMERANGS**
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=0&link=07656c8534b94569a23724ec069d1fdb)
---
**Veteran 22-year congressman Tom Cole who represents the Oklahoma City Oklahoma area is seeking his 12th term and has been caught by surprise by challenge from a successful businessman Paul Bondar who describes himself on his website as a Christian, conservative, successful businessman, husband, father, family man and strong Trump republican. Bondar, who is critical of the House Republican establishment, filed to challenge Cole in the upcoming June 18th primary.** Cole almost immediately launched a hard-hitting negative television advertising attack against the insurgent businessman falsely accusing the challenger of “not owning property in Oklahoma” and “having delinquent unpaid taxes.” Bondar fired off a letter to the veteran Washington insider which you can [read here](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=1&link=56f1c0075c3f40da919e0b4adea26d45). Although Cole himself is registered to vote in a single-family home owned by a trust in his wife’s name, Cole himself has not voted in person on election day in Oklahoma since 2003. A canvas of his neighbors whose homes surround the address from which the veteran congressman is registered to vote, could not recall seeing the Washington insider in recent memory.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=2&link=1fc5c4b243b047b2ad6041cbd1a31ec1)
---
|
---

# **HISPANIC ADVOCATES PLAN RALLY AT OKLAHOMA CAPITAL TO VOICE FRUSTRATION ABOUT NEW IMMIGRATION LAW**
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=3&link=a1f2f2c563504a53a2aaa6a95425529a)
---
**Hispanic and other communities on Wednesday are expected to rally at the Capitol. Organizers of the annual Hispanic Cultural Day at the Capitol have changed the format following the signing of a controversial immigration law.** The event has traditionally been held inside the Capitol and included advocacy, exhibits, food, dancing and booths. But since Gov. Kevin Stitt signed House Bill 4156, the Legislative Latino Caucus received an outpouring of concern, said Rep. Arturo Alonso-Sandoval, D-Oklahoma City. As a result, the group decided to change the format to include a rally, organized advocacy and some cultural celebrations. “This change in format is a direct result of the frustration of folks — not only in the Latino community,” said Sen. Michael Brooks, D-Oklahoma City.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=4&link=17044a6d49b349bb965f68bf7f9527ab)
---
|

# OKLAHOMA HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS WILL HAVE THE CHANCE TO PARTICIPATE IN FIREFIGHTER TRAINING PROGRAM THIS FALL
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=5&link=ff0cd18349bc4e7cbe9ece2f1e55e5d3)
---
**Starting this fall, high school students in Oklahoma will have the opportunity to embark on a hands-on firefighter training program at OSU-OKC, paving the way for the next generation of firefighters in the state. With a pressing need for new recruits in the firefighting workforce, this initiative aims to equip young individuals with the skills and knowledge necessary to serve their communities effectively.** Joe Bennett, the Director of Fire Protection at OSU-OKC, outlined the comprehensive nature of the program, which will cover structural firefighting, auto extrication, and various other essential skills. The curriculum, designed for concurrent enrollment high school students, will offer a blend of theoretical learning and practical training, preparing students for the demands of the firefighting profession. One of the driving forces behind the program is the impending retirement of a significant number of firefighters, creating a void that needs to be filled urgently. Bennett highlighted the need to train new recruits to meet the demands of both career and volunteer firefighting roles across the state.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=6&link=05ea41d464054787a545f8a2faace6ac)

# US GIVING UKRAINE $400 MILLION IN NEW MILITARY AID
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=7&link=a9536f74c17d42769a9a6148a1d3453a)
---
**The United States on Friday announced a new $400 million military aid package for Kyiv as Russia launched a ground offensive in northeast Ukraine.** It is the third package for Ukraine in less than three weeks, following two in late April valued at a total of $7 billion as Washington seeks to make up for months in which it provided only limited assistance. In a memo released by the White House, President Joe Biden authorized the provision of "up to $400 million in defense articles and services of the Department of Defense, and military education and training" to aid Ukraine.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=8&link=446c1df8189f4c28a82f2cb225636786)
---
|

# US SUPREME COURT JUSTICE DISMISSES LAVISH GIFTS REPORT AS LIES
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=9&link=c84ae82b850a48308c9bbcd65c779b9a)
---
**US Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, who has found himself under scrutiny over his judicial decisions and accepting lavish gifts from a billionaire Republican, is dismissing the criticism as "nastiness" and "lies," according to US media.** "There's certainly been a lot of negativity in our lives, my wife and I, over the last few years, but we choose not to focus on it," the New York Times quoted Thomas as saying Friday at a judicial conference in the southern US state of Alabama. Staunch conservative Thomas, the longest-serving justice on the court, has been embroiled in controversy since it emerged last year that he had gone on a trip paid for by Republican donor and real estate tycoon Harlan Crow.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=10&link=b6d49aadb4ad4a9a81dbc37a79622b6a)
---
|

# MOTION TO VACATE TRIGGERED AS JOHNSON VOWS TO PROTECT SPECIAL COUNCIL JACK SMITH
---
| [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=11&link=46ec8e6967dc467abd82b5dd5fd9307d)
---
**In a dramatic turn of events, the Motion to Vacate was triggered yesterday as tensions escalated over the fate of Special Council Jack Smith. House Speaker Mike Johnson's refusal to commit to defunding the council has sparked outrage among some lawmakers, leading to the decisive action.** The controversy began when Johnson not only declined to defund the Special Council but also pledged to protect its existence. This declaration has drawn criticism and raised concerns about Johnson's allegiances within the House. Critics argue that Johnson's stance on the Special Council aligns more closely with Democratic interests than with those of his own party. The decision to protect the council, which some Republicans view as unnecessary and wasteful, has further strained relations within the House.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=1mzq37um8q33ecdzrx&linkid=12&link=5bf949f1079a4e7f9166bd0638f607d4)
